title.zh: 卷456 列傳二百四十三 马如龙 和耀曾 杨玉科 李惟述 蔡标 段瑞梅 夏毓秀 何秀林 杨国發 张保和
title.en: Volume 456 Biographies 243: Ma Rulong, He Yaoceng, Yang Yuke, Li Weishu, Cai Biao, Duan Ruimei, Xia Yuxiu, He Xiulin, Yang Guofa, Zhang Baohe
title.raw: 卷456 列傳二百四十三 马如龙 和耀曾 杨玉科 李惟述 蔡标 段瑞梅 夏毓秀 何秀林 杨国發 张保和

sentences.zh: 馬如龍，雲南建水人，本名現，回中世族。

translations.literal: Ma Rulong was a native of Jianshui in Yunnan; his original name was Xian, and he came from an established Hui clan.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Rulong, a native of Jianshui in Yunnan, was originally named Xian and belonged to a prominent Hui family.

sentences.zh: 以勇聞。

translations.literal: He was known for his bravery.
translations.idiomatic: He won renown for his valor.

sentences.zh: 咸豐間，滇回俶擾，如龍以武生起澂江，自立為偽帥。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng reign, when the Hui of Yunnan rose in sudden disorder, Rulong entered the military through the martial-examination route at Chengjiang and set himself up as a false commander.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era, as the Hui of Yunnan erupted in rebellion, Rulong entered service at Chengjiang through the military examination and proclaimed himself a rebel commander.

sentences.zh: 時杜文秀僭號大理，如龍遣使與通，授以偽職，不受，始有郄。

translations.literal: At that time Du Wenxiu had arrogated the title of ruler at Dali; Rulong sent envoys to communicate with him and was offered a false office, but he did not accept it, and a rift first arose between them.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wenxiu had meanwhile declared himself ruler at Dali. Rulong sent envoys to open relations, but when Wenxiu offered him a rebel post he refused, and the two men first fell out.

sentences.zh: 遂據有新興、昆陽、晉寧、呈貢、嵩明、羅次、易門、富民，入寇省城，勢駸盛。

translations.literal: He then seized and held Xinxing, Kunyang, Jinning, Chenggong, Songming, Luoci, Yimen, and Fumin, raided the provincial capital, and his power grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to seize Xinxing, Kunyang, Jinning, Chenggong, Songming, Luoci, Yimen, and Fumin, marched against the provincial capital, and his power swelled steadily.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，巡撫徐之銘复主撫議，提督林自清臨陣宣播朝威，招之歸款，如龍自稱三世效忠，願反正。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Governor Xu Zhiming again took charge of pacification policy; Regional Commander Lin Ziqing went to the front to proclaim the court's majesty and summon him to submit; Rulong declared that his family had been loyal for three generations and that he wished to return to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, Governor Xu Zhiming revived the policy of conciliation. Regional Commander Lin Ziqing went to the front to proclaim imperial authority and invite surrender. Rulong declared that his family had served loyally for three generations and that he wished to return to the fold.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英單騎往諭，如龍益心折，與盟南門外，悉反侵地。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying went alone on horseback to instruct him; Rulong was all the more won over, made an alliance with him outside the south gate, and returned all the territory he had seized.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying rode out alone to reason with him. Rulong was thoroughly impressed, swore an alliance with him outside the south gate, and restored every inch of occupied land.

sentences.zh: 朝旨破格授如龍總兵，楊振鵬等分署六營武職。

translations.literal: By imperial order Rulong was exceptionally appointed regional commander, and Yang Zhenpeng and others were assigned in turn to the six battalion military posts.
translations.idiomatic: The court broke precedent by appointing Rulong regional commander and assigning Yang Zhenpeng and others to the six battalion commands.

sentences.zh: 是時，臨安獨撓撫局，如龍怒，率師鼓行而南，戰失利，署臨元參將梁士美奪其旗鼓，如龍被創，僕，左右負以奔。

translations.literal: At that time Lin'an alone obstructed the pacification effort; Rulong was enraged, led his army south with drums beating, was defeated in battle, and Acting Lin-Yuan Deputy Commander Liang Shimei seized his banners and drums; Rulong was wounded, fell, and his attendants carried him off in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an alone was then thwarting pacification. Enraged, Rulong marched south at the drumbeat, but was defeated. Acting Deputy Commander Liang Shimei of Lin-Yuan seized his banners and drums. Rulong was wounded, fell from his horse, and his men carried him from the field.

sentences.zh: 總督潘鐸嚴檄其撤兵，如龍阻於士美軍，弗能達。

translations.literal: Governor-General Pan Duo sternly ordered him by dispatch to withdraw his troops, but Rulong was blocked by Shimei's army and could not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Pan Duo issued a stern order to withdraw, but Rulong was hemmed in by Shimei's forces and could not obey.

sentences.zh: 明年，授鶴麗鎮。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed to the He-Li command.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed commander of the He-Li garrison.

sentences.zh: 會回弁馬榮據省城，鐸被害。

translations.literal: It happened that the Hui officer Ma Rong seized the provincial capital and Duo was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Hui officer Ma Rong seized the provincial capital and Pan Duo was murdered.

sentences.zh: 如龍聞警，即致書士美，約共釋私仇，雪公憤，士美許諾，期相見臨安城下。

translations.literal: When Rulong heard the alarm he at once wrote to Shimei, proposing that they set aside private enmity and avenge the governor's death; Shimei agreed and they arranged to meet below the walls of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the news, Rulong wrote at once to Shimei proposing that they lay aside their private feud and avenge the governor. Shimei agreed, and they arranged to meet below the walls of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 如龍貽士美洋槍，士美亦選勁勇助如龍。

translations.literal: Rulong presented Shimei with foreign rifles, and Shimei also selected crack troops to assist Rulong.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong gave Shimei Western rifles, and Shimei in turn sent picked fighters to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 如龍乃星夜旋軍，與毓英共擊之，斬馬士麟、馬有才於陣，榮宵遁，遂代自清署提督。

translations.literal: Rulong then marched his army back by night and, together with Yuying, attacked them; Ma Shilin and Ma Youcai were beheaded in battle, Rong fled by night, and Rulong then acted in place of Lin Ziqing as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong marched back by forced night marches and, joining Yuying, struck the rebels. Ma Shilin and Ma Youcai were slain in battle, while Rong fled under cover of darkness. Rulong then served as acting regional commander in Lin Ziqing's place.

sentences.zh: 武定陷，如龍遣參將馬青雲等馳援，守備夏毓秀先登，克之，連复十餘城。

translations.literal: When Wuding fell, Rulong sent Deputy Commander Ma Qingyun and others to hurry to its relief; Garrison Commander Xia Yuxiu was first to scale the walls and took the city, and more than ten cities were recovered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuding fell, Rulong sent Deputy Commander Ma Qingyun and others to its relief. Garrison Commander Xia Yuxiu was first over the wall and took the city, and more than ten towns were recovered in succession.

sentences.zh: 文秀聞而忌之，致書馬德新，痛斥如龍自殊同教。

translations.literal: When Wenxiu heard of this he grew jealous and wrote to Ma Dexin, bitterly denouncing Rulong for separating himself from their shared faith.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiu, hearing of this, grew resentful and wrote to Ma Dexin, bitterly denouncing Rulong for betraying their co-religionists.

sentences.zh: 如龍亦遍馳書迤西回民，歷數文秀狂悖及德新不諳大義，勸勿為所惑。

translations.literal: Rulong also sent letters far and wide to the Hui of western Yunnan, recounting Wenxiu's reckless defiance and Dexin's failure to understand the greater cause, and urging them not to be misled.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong in turn sent letters throughout western Yunnan to the Hui communities, listing Wenxiu's reckless defiance and Dexin's failure to grasp the larger cause, and urging them not to be deceived.

sentences.zh: 德新入省，申割地媾和議，如龍力止之，事遂寢。

translations.literal: When Dexin entered the province he proposed a peace agreement involving territorial concessions; Rulong strenuously opposed it, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: When Dexin entered the province he proposed a peace based on territorial concessions. Rulong blocked it firmly, and the proposal came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 其秋，攻克尋甸，擒馬榮，解省伏誅。

translations.literal: That autumn they captured Xundian, seized Ma Rong, and sent him to the provincial capital for execution.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they took Xundian, captured Ma Rong, and sent him to the provincial capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 毓英攻曲靖，回懼，願執馬聯昇以獻，乞貸死，如龍馳至軍前，力為請命，許之，剖榮屍祭鐸。

translations.literal: When Yuying attacked Qujing the Hui were afraid and offered to hand over Ma Liansheng in exchange for their lives; Rulong hurried to the front and pleaded strongly on their behalf; permission was granted, and Rong's corpse was dismembered to sacrifice to Duo.
translations.idiomatic: As Yuying besieged Qujing the Hui grew fearful and offered to deliver Ma Liansheng in return for their lives. Rulong rode to the front and pleaded earnestly for them. The court consented, and Rong's body was cut apart as an offering to Pan Duo.

sentences.zh: 迤東平，詔加提督銜，賜號效勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When eastern Yunnan was pacified, an edict added to him the rank of regional commander and bestowed the title Xiaoyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: With eastern Yunnan pacified, he was promoted to regional commander and granted the title Xiaoyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 五年，命主迤西軍事，圖大理。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to take charge of military affairs in western Yunnan and plan the capture of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was placed in command of operations in western Yunnan with orders to take Dali.

sentences.zh: 以振鵬攻賓川，副將李惟述攻鎮南，昭通鎮總兵楊盛宗取道四川攻永北，署騰越鎮田仲興攻蒙化，護普洱鎮李錦文攻威遠，並受如龍節度。

translations.literal: Yang Zhenpeng was sent against Binchuan, Deputy Commander Li Weishu against Zhennan, Zhaotong Commander Yang Shengzong against Yongbei by way of Sichuan, Acting Tengyue Commander Tian Zhongxing against Menghua, and Acting Pu'er Commander Li Jinwen against Weiyuan—all under Rulong's command.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhenpeng attacked Binchuan, Deputy Commander Li Weishu Zhennan, Zhaotong Commander Yang Shengzong Yongbei by way of Sichuan, Acting Tengyue Commander Tian Zhongxing Menghua, and Acting Pu'er Commander Li Jinwen Weiyuan—all under Rulong's overall command.

sentences.zh: 六年，如龍軍次祿豐，適大理回入前場關，遣總兵哈國安、副將楊先芝大破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Rulong's army halted at Lufeng; just then the Dali Hui entered Qianchang Pass, and he sent Regional Commander Ha Guo'an and Deputy Commander Yang Xianzhi, who inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Rulong encamped at Lufeng. When the Dali rebels entered Qianchang Pass he sent Regional Commander Ha Guo'an and Deputy Commander Yang Xianzhi, who routed them decisively.

sentences.zh: 振鵬性陰鷙，不甘為如龍下，至是聞勞崇光卒，叛志遂決；

translations.literal: Zhenpeng was by nature secretive and ruthless and would not submit to serving under Rulong; when he now heard that Lao Chongguang had died, his resolve to rebel was fixed;
translations.idiomatic: Zhenpeng was secretive and ruthless by nature and resented serving under Rulong. When he learned of Lao Chongguang's death, his decision to rebel was made;

sentences.zh: 而國安、先芝亦懷二心，日與寇使往還，軍心乃解體。

translations.literal: and Guo'an and Xianzhi also harbored divided loyalties, exchanging messages daily with the rebels, so that army morale dissolved.
translations.idiomatic: and Guo'an and Xianzhi too wavered in loyalty, exchanging messages daily with the enemy, until the army's morale collapsed.

sentences.zh: 無何，楚雄、大姚相繼告警。

translations.literal: Before long Chuxiong and Dayao sent alarms in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Chuxiong and Dayao sent urgent alarms in turn.

sentences.zh: 時如龍駐定遠，軍數夜驚。

translations.literal: At that time Rulong was stationed at Dingyuan, and the army was alarmed night after night.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong was then stationed at Dingyuan, and the camp was thrown into panic night after night.

sentences.zh: 群目或擁兵觀望，或臨陣先奔，或竟為寇充鄉導。

translations.literal: Among the officers some held their troops back to watch, some fled before the battle was joined, and some even served the rebels as local guides.
translations.idiomatic: Some officers held their men back to wait and see, others fled before the fighting began, and still others served the enemy as guides.

sentences.zh: 如龍知勢已去，乃稱疾還省，自是文秀遂輕視如龍矣。

translations.literal: Rulong knew the situation was lost, claimed illness, and returned to the provincial capital; from then on Wenxiu looked down on Rulong.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that the tide had turned, Rulong pleaded illness and returned to the capital. From then on Wenxiu held him in contempt.

sentences.zh: 七年，大舉犯省城，如龍以回練不足恃，乃專倚漢兵守城，斥私財三萬金、米三千石濟軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the rebels launched a major assault on the provincial capital; Rulong judged the Hui militia unreliable and relied solely on Han troops to defend the city, spending thirty thousand taels of his private wealth and three thousand piculs of grain to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the rebels launched a major assault on the capital. Judging the Hui militia unreliable, Rulong relied solely on Han troops for the defense and spent thirty thousand taels of his own money and three thousand piculs of grain to supply them.

sentences.zh: 晨夜登陴守，擊寇梁家河，破之，寇稍卻。

translations.literal: Day and night he mounted the battlements to defend, struck the rebels at Liangjia River, defeated them, and the enemy withdrew somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night he manned the walls, struck the rebels at Liangjia River and broke them, and the enemy drew back somewhat.

sentences.zh: 初，振鵬之叛也，約國安等為內應，至是國安謀刺如龍，事覺，誘誅之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhenpeng rebelled, he had arranged for Guo'an and others to act as inside collaborators; now Guo'an plotted to assassinate Rulong; the plot was discovered and he was lured out and executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenpeng had rebelled he had arranged for Guo'an and others to act as inside collaborators. Guo'an now plotted to assassinate Rulong, but the plot was discovered and he was lured out and killed.

sentences.zh: 先芝等頗自危，會如龍出大西門擊寇，戰方酣，先芝等遂倒戈回刃，如龍幾不免，亟馳入益兵禦守。

translations.literal: Xianzhi and the others felt themselves in danger; just as Rulong went out the great west gate to attack the rebels and the battle was at its height, Xianzhi and the others turned their blades on their own side; Rulong nearly perished, and he hurried back inside to bring up more troops for the defense.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhi and his fellows grew fearful for themselves. As Rulong sallied from the great west gate and the fighting was at its fiercest, they turned their swords on their own side. Rulong narrowly escaped, galloped back inside, and brought up reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 於是馬世德、馬文照、馬葵等相率叛歸文秀，偪南城，據江右館，人心大震。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ma Shide, Ma Wenzhao, Ma Kui, and others led their men in rebellion back to Wenxiu, pressed the south wall, seized the Jiangyou Lodge, and popular morale was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shide, Ma Wenzhao, Ma Kui, and others then defected en masse to Wenxiu, pressed the south wall, and seized the Jiangyou Lodge. Panic spread through the city.

sentences.zh: 適惟述、馬忠援師至，勸其與毓英協力，如龍然之，踵軍門上謁。

translations.literal: Just then the relief forces of Weishu and Ma Zhong arrived and urged him to cooperate with Yuying; Rulong agreed and followed them to the commander's gate to pay his respects.
translations.idiomatic: Relief forces under Li Weishu and Ma Zhong then arrived and urged him to cooperate with Yuying. Rulong agreed and went in person to Yuying's headquarters to pay his respects.

sentences.zh: 毓英推誠慰勞，勗以報國，如龍益用命。

translations.literal: Yuying received him with sincerity and comfort, exhorted him to serve the state, and Rulong became all the more devoted in his service.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying received him with open sincerity, exhorted him to serve the dynasty, and Rulong redoubled his efforts.

sentences.zh: 俄而文秀遣悍黨數万出賓川，如龍分部兵二千御之。

translations.literal: Before long Wenxiu sent tens of thousands of fierce fighters out of Binchuan, and Rulong detached two thousand men to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wenxiu sent tens of thousands of hardened fighters from Binchuan, and Rulong detached two thousand men to hold them.

sentences.zh: 武定附省，回久閉門不戰，突出奪大虹山二壘，如龍親擊之，拔其一。

translations.literal: Wuding adjoined the provincial capital; the Hui there had long kept their gates shut and would not fight, then suddenly sallied forth and seized two forts on Dahong Mountain; Rulong attacked in person and captured one of them.
translations.idiomatic: Wuding lay close to the capital. The Hui there had long refused battle, then suddenly sallied forth and seized two forts on Dahong Mountain. Rulong attacked in person and took one.

sentences.zh: 毓英攻澂江，馬自新率眾往援，未至，如龍诇知之，遣馬興勤馳入鐍兮，計斬自新，外援頓絕。

translations.literal: Yuying attacked Chengjiang; Ma Zixin led troops to its relief but had not yet arrived when Rulong learned of it through reconnaissance, sent Ma Xingqin in forced march into Suoxi, and by stratagem killed Zixin, so that outside relief was cut off at once.
translations.idiomatic: As Yuying besieged Chengjiang, Ma Zixin marched to its relief. Before he arrived Rulong learned of it through scouts and sent Ma Xingqin in a forced march into Suoxi, where by stratagem Zixin was killed and outside relief cut off.

sentences.zh: 澂江既下，又分兵攻城外賀家村、小魚村、下普坪，並克之。

translations.literal: After Chengjiang fell he again divided his forces to attack Hejia Village, Xiaoyu Village, and Xiapuping outside the walls, and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: After Chengjiang fell he sent detachments against Hejia Village, Xiaoyu Village, and Xiapuping outside the walls and took them all.

sentences.zh: 八年，與毓英攻江右館，寇轟拒，洞穿如龍甲，卒大破之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, together with Yuying, he attacked the Jiangyou Lodge; the rebels resisted with cannon fire that pierced Rulong's armor, yet in the end they were thoroughly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he and Yuying attacked the Jiangyou Lodge. Rebel cannon fire pierced Rulong's armor, yet in the end the rebels were routed.

sentences.zh: 先後連克武定、羅次，更勇號法什尚阿。

translations.literal: In succession they captured Wuding and Luoci, and he was given the enhanced brave title Fashishang'a.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Wuding and Luoci in turn, and he was granted the enhanced title Fashishang'a.

sentences.zh: 已而澂江再陷，城外寇勢复熾。

translations.literal: Before long Chengjiang fell again and rebel strength outside the walls revived.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Chengjiang fell again and rebel strength outside the walls surged anew.

sentences.zh: 毓英攻城南巨壘，如龍方臥病，聞槍砲聲，力疾赴前敵，攻克五花寺、羊神廟，乘勝偪江右館，如龍先登，彈中腹，踣地，舁之歸。

translations.literal: Yuying attacked the great fort south of the city; Rulong was then ill in bed, but hearing the sound of muskets and cannon he forced himself to the front, captured Wuhua Temple and Yangshen Shrine, pressed the advantage against the Jiangyou Lodge, was first to scale the wall, was struck in the belly by a bullet, fell to the ground, and was carried back.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying attacked the great fort south of the city. Rulong lay ill in bed, but at the sound of gunfire he dragged himself to the front, took Wuhua Temple and Yangshen Shrine, and pressed the advantage against the Jiangyou Lodge. He was first over the wall, was shot in the belly, fell, and was carried back.

sentences.zh: 毓英上聞，賜內府丹藥，予實授。

translations.literal: Yuying reported to the throne; the court bestowed imperial pharmacy medicines and granted him substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying reported to the throne. The court sent medicines from the imperial pharmacy and confirmed his appointment in substantive rank.

sentences.zh: 復與毓英分軍攻安寧各隘，扼寇歸路。

translations.literal: He again divided forces with Yuying to attack the passes of Anning and block the rebels' line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: He and Yuying again divided their forces to seize the passes of Anning and cut the rebels' retreat.

sentences.zh: 群回益蹙，其酋段成功、蔡廷棟先獻款。

translations.literal: The Hui forces grew ever more pressed; their chiefs Duan Chenggong and Cai Tingdong were first to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hui forces grew desperate. Their chiefs Duan Chenggong and Cai Tingdong were the first to surrender.

sentences.zh: 如龍扶病出城，與毓英嚴兵以待，成功等率五千人伏地請罪，南關告寧，遣兵攻克西壩。

translations.literal: Rulong, supporting himself despite illness, went out of the city and, with Yuying, arrayed strict troops to receive them; Chenggong and the others led five thousand men to prostrate themselves and beg forgiveness; the south gate was declared secure, and troops were sent to capture Xiba.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong, still ill, went out with Yuying and drew up strict formations to receive them. Chenggong and the others led five thousand men to prostrate themselves and beg pardon. The south gate was secured, and troops were sent to take Xiba.

sentences.zh: 時毓英克江右館，俘虜多，如龍躬詣寇營，勒回自相斬獻，省城圍始解。

translations.literal: At that time Yuying had captured the Jiangyou Lodge and taken many prisoners; Rulong went in person to the rebel camps and compelled the Hui to kill one another and present the heads, and only then was the siege of the provincial capital lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying had taken the Jiangyou Lodge with many prisoners. Rulong went in person to the rebel camps and compelled the Hui to kill one another and present the heads. Only then was the siege of the capital lifted.

sentences.zh: 餘匪併入土堆。

translations.literal: The remaining bandits all gathered at Tudui.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining rebels gathered at Tudui.

sentences.zh: 師攻昆陽亟，回酋赴省乞撫。

translations.literal: As the army pressed the attack on Kunyang, the Hui chiefs came to the provincial capital to beg for pacification.
translations.idiomatic: As the army pressed Kunyang hard, Hui chiefs came to the capital to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 振鵬畏誅，猶嵎負。

translations.literal: Zhenpeng, fearing execution, still held out in a corner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenpeng, fearing execution, still held out defiantly.

sentences.zh: 如龍渡滇池至，遣將執悍目馬似良，陰散其枝黨。

translations.literal: Rulong crossed Dianchi Lake to arrive, sent an officer to seize the fierce sub-chief Ma Siliang, and secretly dispersed his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong crossed Dianchi Lake, sent an officer to seize the fierce sub-chief Ma Siliang, and secretly broke up his faction.

sentences.zh: 聲某日還，振鵬出送，捕治之，昆陽平。

translations.literal: He announced that he would return on a certain day; Zhenpeng came out to see him off and was seized and punished, and Kunyang was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He announced a date for his return. Zhenpeng came out to see him off and was seized. Kunyang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 毓英攻土堆，如龍率師來會，縱火攻之，省城外遂無遺寇。

translations.literal: Yuying attacked Tudui; Rulong led his army to join him, set fire to assault it, and thereafter no rebels remained outside the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying attacked Tudui. Rulong brought his army to join him and assaulted it with fire. No rebels remained outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 九年，如龍出督新興軍，田仲興戰死，如龍亦被創，斷東溝困之，拔其城，遂統全軍赴河西擊東溝。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Rulong went out to direct the Xinxing army; Tian Zhongxing died in battle and Rulong was also wounded; he cut off Donggou to besiege it, captured its town, then took command of the whole army and went to Hexi to attack Donggou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Rulong took command of operations at Xinxing. Tian Zhongxing was killed in battle and Rulong was wounded. He cut off Donggou, besieged it, and took the town, then led the full army to Hexi to attack Donggou.

sentences.zh: 溝分大小二寨，哈國治、馬成林分居之，並背山面田，勢險奧。

translations.literal: The gully was divided into large and small stockades, with Ha Guozhi and Ma Chenglin stationed in them respectively; both backed onto mountains and faced fields, and the terrain was perilous and deep.
translations.idiomatic: The gully was divided into large and small stockades held by Ha Guozhi and Ma Chenglin. Both backed onto mountains and faced the fields, in terrain that was steep and difficult.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，先攻小東溝，盡選河西壯勇助擊。

translations.literal: After more than a year he first attacked Little Donggou, selecting all the stalwart fighters of Hexi to assist in the assault.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he attacked Little Donggou first, mustering every able fighter from Hexi to join the assault.

sentences.zh: 回懼，縛國治乞降，受而誅之。

translations.literal: The Hui were afraid, bound Guozhi, and begged to surrender; Rulong accepted and then executed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Hui grew fearful, bound Guozhi, and begged to surrender. Rulong accepted and then executed him.

sentences.zh: 進取大東溝，如龍陷陣，為槍所中，創甚，越三月小差。

translations.literal: Advancing against Great Donggou, Rulong plunged into the battle line, was struck by a musket, was gravely wounded, and after three months was slightly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Great Donggou, Rulong plunged into the thick of the fight, was shot, and was gravely wounded. After three months he was somewhat recovered.

sentences.zh: 直抵龍門村，奮擊破之。

translations.literal: He pressed straight to Longmen Village and, fighting fiercely, broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed straight to Longmen Village and broke the enemy in fierce fighting.

sentences.zh: 全滇底定，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: When all Yunnan was settled he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: With all Yunnan pacified he was awarded the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 十三年，調湖南。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，創發，乞歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu his old wound reopened and he begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu his old wound reopened and he requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 如龍性豪縱，筦雲南提篆日，惟娛聲色。

translations.literal: Rulong was by nature bold and unrestrained; while he held the seal of Yunnan regional commander he devoted himself only to music and women.
translations.idiomatic: Rulong was bold and unrestrained by nature. While he held command in Yunnan he devoted himself chiefly to pleasure.

sentences.zh: 巡撫賈洪詔彈之，置勿問。

translations.literal: Governor Jia Hongzhao impeached him, but the matter was set aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Jia Hongzhao impeached him, but the court took no action.

sentences.zh: 既閒廢，徙居四川重慶，益不自檢。

translations.literal: After he was dismissed from office he moved to Chongqing in Sichuan and became even less restrained.
translations.idiomatic: After his dismissal he moved to Chongqing in Sichuan and became even less restrained in his conduct.

sentences.zh: 每宴客，招妓侑酒，琵琶聲中輒慷慨道少年時事雲。

translations.literal: Whenever he entertained guests he summoned singing girls to accompany the wine, and amid the sound of pipa he would speak with fervor of his youthful exploits.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he entertained guests he summoned courtesans to pour the wine, and amid the pipa's notes he would speak fervently of his youthful exploits.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died, and mourning was granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died, and mourning honors were granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 和耀曾，雲南麗江人。

translations.literal: He Yaoceng was a native of Lijiang in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He Yaoceng was a native of Lijiang in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 父鑑，大理城守營都司。

translations.literal: His father Jian was a battalion commander of the Dali city garrison.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jian had been battalion commander of the Dali city garrison.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，太和回謀亂，往覘之，被殺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng the Hui of Taihe plotted rebellion; he went to reconnoiter and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng the Hui of Taihe plotted rebellion. He went to investigate and was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔贈雲騎尉世職，耀曾襲，矢復仇，毀家募士。

translations.literal: An edict granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain; Yaoceng inherited it, swore revenge, and ruined his family to recruit warriors.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain. Yaoceng inherited it, swore revenge, and spent his family's fortune to raise troops.

sentences.zh: 與賓川廩生董文蘭會師洱河，兩克大理及鄧川、上關，以義勇著，遠近爭歸附。

translations.literal: He joined forces with Binchuan licentiate Dong Wenlan at Er River, twice captured Dali as well as Dengchuan and Shangguan, became renowned as a righteous volunteer, and men near and far vied to join him.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Binchuan licentiate Dong Wenlan at Er River, twice took Dali along with Dengchuan and Shangguan, won fame as a righteous volunteer, and men near and far flocked to his banner.

sentences.zh: 楊玉科、張潤並隸麾下，後皆為名將。

translations.literal: Yang Yuke and Zhang Run both served under his command and later became famous generals.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuke and Zhang Run both served under him and later became celebrated generals.

sentences.zh: 總督吳振棫薦其才，署中營守備。

translations.literal: Governor-General Wu Zhenbang recommended his talent, and he was appointed acting commander of the central battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Wu Zhenbang recommended his ability, and he was appointed acting commander of the central battalion.

sentences.zh: 十年，權維西協左營都司。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as battalion commander of the left battalion of the Weixi command.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he served as acting battalion commander of the left battalion of the Weixi command.

sentences.zh: 明年，大理回來犯，敗之於橋頭。

translations.literal: The following year the Dali Hui came to attack again and he defeated them at Qiaotou.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Dali rebels attacked again and he defeated them at Qiaotou.

sentences.zh: 已而祿豐、昆陽陷，复率把總高聯甲戰石鼓，大破之。

translations.literal: Before long Lufeng and Kunyang fell; he again led Platoon Commander Gao Lianjia to fight at Shigu and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Lufeng and Kunyang fell. He again led Platoon Commander Gao Lianjia into battle at Shigu and won a decisive victory.

sentences.zh: 乘勝攻克麗江，留土弁王天爵駐守，而自引兵規鶴慶。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he captured Lijiang, left the native officer Wang Tianjue to garrison it, and himself led troops to plan the capture of Heqing.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory he took Lijiang, left native officer Wang Tianjue to garrison it, and marched himself toward Heqing.

sentences.zh: 寇乘隙再陷麗城，耀曾軍失利，退守石鼓。

translations.literal: The rebels seized the opportunity to capture Lijiang city again; Yaoceng's army was defeated and withdrew to hold Shigu.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels seized the moment and retook Lijiang. Yaoceng's army was beaten and fell back to Shigu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，再克之，遷參將。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured it again and was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he recaptured it and was promoted to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 徙頓曲靖，夷卡郎寇巢，略昭通，戰公​​雞山、龍洞，師弗勝。

translations.literal: He moved to encamp at Qujing, attacked the rebel nest of Kalang among the Yi, raided Zhaotong, fought at Gongji Mountain and Longdong, and the army did not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: He encamped at Qujing, attacked the Yi rebel stronghold at Kalang, raided toward Zhaotong, and fought at Gongji Mountain and Longdong without success.

sentences.zh: 與護昭通鎮楊盛宗往援，斬其酋所朝昇，遷副將，徙守富平。

translations.literal: Together with Acting Zhaotong Commander Yang Shengzong he went to their relief, beheaded the rebel chief Suo Chaosheng, was promoted to deputy regional commander, and was transferred to guard Fuping.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Acting Zhaotong Commander Yang Shengzong in relief, beheaded the rebel chief Suo Chaosheng, was promoted to deputy regional commander, and was transferred to guard Fuping.

sentences.zh: 八年，城陷，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the city fell, and he was stripped of office and arrested for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the city fell and he was stripped of rank and arrested for trial.

sentences.zh: 尋以克楚雄、祿豐，貸勿治，留軍自贖。

translations.literal: Soon, because he had captured Chuxiong and Lufeng, he was pardoned from punishment and left with the army to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, for capturing Chuxiong and Lufeng, he was pardoned and allowed to remain with the army to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 十年，克澂江，复官。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he captured Chengjiang and was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he took Chengjiang and was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 明年，攻迤西，連破蒙化、趙州、上下關，於是大理籓籬盡失。

translations.literal: The following year he attacked western Yunnan, captured Menghua, Zhaozhou, and Shangguan and Xiaguan in succession, and thereby Dali lost all its outer defenses.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he attacked western Yunnan, took Menghua, Zhaozhou, and the upper and lower passes in succession, and Dali lost every outer defense.

sentences.zh: 是冬，穴地道轟其城，拔之。

translations.literal: That winter he tunneled under the walls and blasted them with mines, and captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he tunneled under the walls, blasted them with mines, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 又明年，取大小圍埂。

translations.literal: The year after that he took the great and small Weiheng stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he took the great and small Weiheng stockades.

sentences.zh: 積勳晉記名總兵，賜號達春巴圖魯。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he was advanced to registered regional commander and granted the title Dachun Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: For accumulated merit he was advanced to registered regional commander and granted the title Dachun Batulu.

sentences.zh: 自是與玉科定錫臘，下順寧，破雲州，擢提督。

translations.literal: From then on, together with Yuke, he pacified Xila, descended on Shunning, broke Yunzhou, and was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, with Yuke, he pacified Xila, took Shunning, broke Yunzhou, and was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 進克小猛統，大吏以叛產予其殘廢部伍，固辭弗獲，乃斥家財遣之歸，而以其地佐書院餐錢及賓興費，並選開敏子弟集廨宇，延師課讀。

translations.literal: Advancing, he captured Xiaomengtong; high officials offered him rebel property for his disabled troops, but he firmly refused and could not be persuaded; he then spent his family wealth to send them home, used the land to supplement the academy board and examination expenses, and selected bright youths to gather at the yamen, where teachers were invited to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced and took Xiaomengtong. Officials offered him rebel property for his disabled troops, but he firmly refused. He spent his own fortune to send them home, devoted the land to the academy's board and examination funds, and gathered bright youths at his headquarters for instruction.

sentences.zh: 又與李惟述克騰越。

translations.literal: He again joined Li Weishu in capturing Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Li Weishu in taking Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 全滇平，賞黃馬褂，檄署永昌協。

translations.literal: When all Yunnan was pacified he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket and ordered by dispatch to act as commander of the Yongchang command.
translations.idiomatic: With all Yunnan pacified he was awarded the yellow riding jacket and ordered to act as commander of the Yongchang garrison.

sentences.zh: 永昌自遭喪亂，比戶凋殘。

translations.literal: Yongchang, since suffering the calamity of rebellion, had households devastated household by household.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang, since the rebellion, had seen household after household ruined.

sentences.zh: 耀曾至，撫流亡，除苛擾，革姦暴，教之治生，民漸復業。

translations.literal: When Yaoceng arrived he comforted the displaced, removed harsh exactions, reformed violence and corruption, taught the people how to make a living, and gradually they returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: When Yaoceng arrived he comforted the displaced, ended harsh exactions, curbed violence and corruption, taught the people how to earn a living, and gradually they returned to their trades.

sentences.zh: 時烏索賊柳映蒼复叛，奉檄與總兵徐聯魁等會擊。

translations.literal: At that time the Wusuo bandit Liu Yingcang rebelled again, and by order he joined Regional Commander Xu Liankui and others in a combined attack.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusuo bandit Liu Yingcang rebelled again, and by order he joined Regional Commander Xu Liankui and others in a combined campaign.

sentences.zh: 十三年，克之，以次削平土司諸地。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he captured them and in succession reduced the native chieftain territories.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he took them and in succession pacified the native chieftain territories.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，參將蘇開先誘練軍譁變，據騰越。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu Deputy Commander Su Kaixian incited the militia to mutiny and seized Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu, Deputy Commander Su Kaixian incited the militia to mutiny and seized Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 王道士與合，順、雲豪姦悍卒乘機竊發，永昌練目李朝應之，掠施甸，迤西大擾。

translations.literal: Daoist Wang joined with him; fierce and violent soldiers of Shunning and Yunzhou seized the opportunity to rise in secret; Yongchang militia officer Li Chao responded, plundered Shidian, and western Yunnan was greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Daoist Wang joined the rebels. Fierce soldiers in Shunning and Yunzhou seized the moment to rise, Yongchang militia officer Li Chao answered the call, plundered Shidian, and western Yunnan was thrown into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英以耀曾諳究邊情，奏署騰越總兵。

translations.literal: Because Yaoceng was thoroughly versed in border conditions, Cen Yuying memorialized that he act as Tengyue regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying, knowing Yaoceng's deep familiarity with the border, memorialized that he act as regional commander at Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 耀曾為固本計，先赴永昌，調團守隘，率師追討，擊潰李朝，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: To consolidate his base Yaoceng first went to Yongchang, mobilized militia to guard the passes, led his army in pursuit, routed Li Chao, and all the remaining factions were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: To secure his base Yaoceng went first to Yongchang, mobilized militia to hold the passes, led troops in pursuit, routed Li Chao, and pacified every remaining faction.

sentences.zh: 總督劉長佑謂其不即至，劾之，鐫二級；

translations.literal: Governor-General Liu Changyou impeached him for not arriving at once and reduced him two grades;
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Liu Changyou impeached him for not arriving promptly and reduced him two grades;

sentences.zh: 論克順、雲功，免議，權漢中鎮總兵。

translations.literal: but in consideration of his merit in pacifying Shunning and Yunzhou he was exempted from further punishment and appointed acting regional commander of the Hanzhong garrison.
translations.idiomatic: but in view of his merit in pacifying Shunning and Yunzhou he was spared further punishment and appointed acting regional commander at Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔各省督撫舉將才，毓英以耀曾應，擢授鎮遠鎮。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict ordered governors and governors-general of all provinces to recommend military talent; Yuying nominated Yaoceng, who was promoted and appointed to the Zhenyuan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the court ordered all provinces to recommend military talent. Yuying nominated Yaoceng, who was promoted to command the Zhenyuan garrison.

sentences.zh: 居鎮十六年，節虛糜，贍儲積，為置營田，建兵房，制器械，軍政大治。

translations.literal: He held the command for sixteen years, curbed waste, provided for stores and reserves, established camp fields, built barracks, regulated weapons, and military administration was greatly ordered.
translations.idiomatic: He held the command for sixteen years, curbed waste, built up stores and reserves, established camp farms, built barracks, standardized weapons, and brought military administration to excellent order.

sentences.zh: 復以其餘設義塾，平道路，勸農桑，士議謂有儒將風。

translations.literal: With what remained he also established charity schools, leveled roads, and encouraged agriculture and sericulture; scholars said he had the bearing of a Confucian general.
translations.idiomatic: With the surplus he founded charity schools, improved roads, and encouraged farming and sericulture. Scholars said he had the bearing of a scholar-general.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he died.

sentences.zh: 民感其德，請附祀毓英祠，麗江亦建祠致祭焉。

translations.literal: The people were moved by his virtue and requested that he be worshipped in association at Yuying's shrine; Lijiang also built a shrine to offer sacrifice to him.
translations.idiomatic: The people, moved by his virtue, asked that he be honored at Yuying's shrine, and Lijiang also built a shrine in his memory.

sentences.zh: 楊玉科，字云階，寄籍麗江。

translations.literal: Yang Yuke, courtesy name Yunjie, was registered as a native of Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuke, courtesy name Yunjie, was registered as a native of Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 其先居湖南善化，既貴，還本籍。

translations.literal: His ancestors had lived in Shanhua in Hunan; after he rose to eminence he returned to his original registry.
translations.idiomatic: His family had originally lived in Shanhua, Hunan. After he rose to eminence he restored his original household registration.

sentences.zh: 同治初，從和耀曾討回。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tongzhi he followed He Yaoceng in campaigning against the Hui rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tongzhi reign he followed He Yaoceng in campaigning against the Hui rebels.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英徵曲靖，識拔之，命領百人為前鋒，積功至守備。

translations.literal: When Cen Yuying campaigned at Qujing he recognized and promoted him, ordered him to lead a hundred men as vanguard, and through accumulated merit he rose to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Cen Yuying campaigned at Qujing he recognized Yuke's talent, made him lead a hundred men as vanguard, and through accumulated merit he rose to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，署維西協。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he acted as commander of the Weixi command.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he served as acting commander of the Weixi garrison.

sentences.zh: 李祖裕叛，殺把總陳聰。

translations.literal: Li Zuyu rebelled and killed Platoon Commander Chen Cong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zuyu rebelled and killed Platoon Commander Chen Cong.

sentences.zh: 毓英慮生變，檄玉科代之。

translations.literal: Yuying feared further trouble and ordered Yuke by dispatch to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing further trouble, Yuying ordered Yuke by dispatch to replace him.

sentences.zh: 玉科至，刺殺祖裕，宣諭部眾，皆伏服，遂克麗江、鶴慶，繇是顯名。

translations.literal: When Yuke arrived he stabbed and killed Zuyu, proclaimed instructions to the troops, and all submitted; he then captured Lijiang and Heqing, and from this his fame became manifest.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuke arrived he killed Zuyu, addressed the troops, and won their submission. He then took Lijiang and Heqing, and from that time his fame spread.

sentences.zh: 俄而杜文秀來援，擁眾可二十萬。

translations.literal: Before long Du Wenxiu came to their relief with a force of perhaps two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Du Wenxiu came to their relief with a force of perhaps two hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 玉科所部止數千人，屢戰弗勝。

translations.literal: Yuke's command numbered only a few thousand men, and in repeated battles they could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Yuke had only a few thousand men under his command and could not win repeated engagements.

sentences.zh: 二城复陷，玉科潰圍出走永北。

translations.literal: Both cities fell again; Yuke broke out of the encirclement and fled to Yongbei.
translations.idiomatic: Both cities fell again. Yuke broke through the encirclement and fled to Yongbei.

sentences.zh: 六年，從克鎮雄，長驅豬供箐、海馬姑，與有功，敘游擊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he took part in capturing Zhenxiong, drove deep into Zhugong Ravine and Haimagu, shared in the merit, and was recorded for promotion to mobile corps commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he helped take Zhenxiong, drove deep into Zhugong Ravine and Haimagu, shared in the victory, and was promoted to mobile corps commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，西寇環偪省城，玉科繞四川會理，間道襲元謀、馬街，規武祿，抄其後，克之，進平羅次。

translations.literal: In the seventh year western rebels surrounded and pressed the provincial capital; Yuke went around by Huili in Sichuan, struck Yuanmou and Majie by a hidden route, planned against Wulu, took them in the rear, captured them, and advanced to pacify Luoci.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year western rebels besieged the capital. Yuke marched by way of Huili in Sichuan, struck Yuanmou and Majie by a hidden route, threatened Wulu from the rear, took it, and advanced to pacify Luoci.

sentences.zh: 八年，平柯渡、可郎，遷副將，賜號勵勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he pacified Kedu and Kelang, was promoted to deputy regional commander, and was granted the title Liyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he pacified Kedu and Kelang, was promoted to deputy regional commander, and was granted the title Liyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 乘勝規嵩明，下尋甸。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he planned against Songming and descended on Xundian.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory he moved on Songming and took Xundian.

sentences.zh: 毓英奏令主三姚軍事，連復大姚、浪鄧。

translations.literal: Yuying memorialized that he be placed in charge of military affairs in the three Yao districts, and he recovered Dayao and Langdeng in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying memorialized that he take command in the three Yao districts, and he recovered Dayao and Langdeng in succession.

sentences.zh: 省城圍解，擢總兵。

translations.literal: When the siege of the provincial capital was lifted he was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege of the capital was lifted he was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 明年，破姚州土城，被巨創。

translations.literal: The following year he broke the earthen walls of Yaozhou and was gravely wounded.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he breached the earthen walls of Yaozhou and was gravely wounded.

sentences.zh: 益開地道三十餘穴，雷發，北城陷，遂拔，擒偽將馬金保、藍平貴。

translations.literal: He further opened more than thirty tunnel shafts, set off mines, the north wall collapsed, and the city was taken; the false generals Ma Jinbao and Lan Pinggui were captured.
translations.idiomatic: He opened more than thirty mining tunnels, set off charges, and the north wall collapsed. The city fell, and the rebel generals Ma Jinbao and Lan Pinggui were captured.

sentences.zh: 三姚平，擢提督，易勇號瑚松額。

translations.literal: When the three Yao districts were pacified he was promoted to regional commander and his brave title was changed to Husonge.
translations.idiomatic: With the three Yao districts pacified he was promoted to regional commander and his title was changed to Husonge.

sentences.zh: 無何，州西警，復令主大理、麗江軍事，發全師速援賓、鄧，遂敗寇雲南驛。

translations.literal: Before long an alarm arose west of the province; he was again ordered to take charge of military affairs in Dali and Lijiang, sent his whole army in rapid relief to Binchuan and Dengchuan, and defeated the rebels at Yunnan Post.
translations.idiomatic: Before long trouble broke out in the west. He was again placed in command at Dali and Lijiang, sent his full army to relieve Binchuan and Dengchuan, and defeated the rebels at Yunnan Post.

sentences.zh: 其冬，克長邑村，進規鍊鐵，擒偽都督楊占鵬。

translations.literal: That winter he captured Changyi Village, advanced against Liantie, and seized the false grand commander Yang Zhanpeng.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he took Changyi Village, advanced on Liantie, and captured the rebel grand commander Yang Zhanpeng.

sentences.zh: 於是大理北路定，權開化鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Thereupon the northern route to Dali was settled, and he was appointed acting regional commander of the Kaihua garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The northern route to Dali was then secured, and he was appointed acting regional commander at Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 十年春，克賓川。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year he captured Binchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the tenth year he took Binchuan.

sentences.zh: 初，永昌之陷也，玉科為偽將馬雙元所得，見其人可用，勸歸命，與訂交，囑異時得志相援手，縱之歸。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yongchang fell, Yuke was taken by the false general Ma Shuangyuan; seeing that the man could be used, Shuangyuan urged him to submit, made a pact of friendship with him, charged him that when either rose in fortune they should aid each other, and let him go.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongchang had fallen earlier, Yuke was captured by the rebel general Ma Shuangyuan. Seeing talent in him, Shuangyuan urged him to submit, swore friendship, asked that when either rose in fortune they should aid each other, and let him go.

sentences.zh: 至是約為內應，克之，署提督。

translations.literal: Now he arranged to act as inside collaborator, captured the city, and was appointed acting regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Now he arranged to act as inside collaborator, took the city, and was appointed acting regional commander.

sentences.zh: 攻大理小關，邑寇詐降，設座禮拜寺，約玉科往。

translations.literal: Attacking the minor pass of Dali, the local rebels feigned surrender, set up seats in a temple, and invited Yuke to come.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking the minor pass of Dali, local rebels feigned surrender, set seats in a temple, and invited Yuke to come.

sentences.zh: 比入，心動，命移座；

translations.literal: As he entered he felt uneasy and ordered the seat moved;
translations.idiomatic: As he entered he felt uneasy and ordered the seat moved;

sentences.zh: 動如故，命再移，有間，地雷發，得不死。

translations.literal: it was moved as before, he ordered it moved again, and after a moment a land mine exploded; he escaped death.
translations.idiomatic: it was moved as before, he ordered it moved again, and after a moment a land mine exploded. He survived.

sentences.zh: 玉科怒，手刃四人，雙元銳身護之出，竟復其地。

translations.literal: Yuke was enraged, killed four men with his own hand, and Shuangyuan threw himself forward to shield him and bring him out; in the end the place was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Yuke killed four men with his own hand. Shuangyuan shielded him and brought him out, and in the end the place was recovered.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，連下漾濞、趙州，進規大理。

translations.literal: After more than a year he captured Yangbi and Zhaozhou in succession and advanced to plan the capture of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he took Yangbi and Zhaozhou in succession and advanced on Dali.

sentences.zh: 其地東臨洱海，西倚蒼山，自文秀竊據，內築土垣，包偽禁城其中。

translations.literal: The place faced Erhai Lake on the east and leaned on Cang Mountain on the west; since Wenxiu had seized it he had built earthen walls within, enclosing the false imperial city inside.
translations.idiomatic: The city faced Erhai Lake on the east and Cang Mountain on the west. Since Wenxiu's seizure he had built inner earthen walls enclosing a rebel palace within.

sentences.zh: 玉科掘隧以攻，轟潰東南城，諸軍蹈隙入。

translations.literal: Yuke tunneled to attack, blasted and breached the southeast wall, and the armies entered through the gap.
translations.idiomatic: Yuke tunneled under the walls, blasted the southeast corner, and the armies poured through the breach.

sentences.zh: 寇死拒，复窖地雷破之。

translations.literal: The rebels resisted to the death; he again buried land mines and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels resisted to the death. He buried more mines and broke them.

sentences.zh: 頓蓮花池，益師五千環攻城。

translations.literal: He halted at Lotus Pond, brought up five thousand more troops, and surrounded the city.
translations.idiomatic: He halted at Lotus Pond, brought up five thousand reinforcements, and surrounded the city.

sentences.zh: 文秀開壁出盪，親擊之。

translations.literal: Wenxiu opened the walls and sallied forth to attack; Yuke struck him in person.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiu sallied from the walls to attack, and Yuke met him in person.

sentences.zh: 敗退，飲毒不即死，其黨蔡廷棟舁以獻，氣息僅屬，割其首解送省城。

translations.literal: Defeated, he withdrew, drank poison but did not die at once; his follower Cai Tingdong carried him forward to surrender; he had only breath left; his head was cut off and sent to the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Defeated, he withdrew and drank poison but did not die at once. His follower Cai Tingdong carried him out to surrender. Barely alive, Wenxiu was beheaded and his head sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 毓英至，廷棟佯乞款，陰埋地雷於行館，迎玉科。

translations.literal: When Yuying arrived Tingdong feigned a plea for surrender, secretly buried land mines at the guest lodge, and welcomed Yuke.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuying arrived, Tingdong feigned surrender, secretly buried mines at the guest lodge, and welcomed Yuke.

sentences.zh: 玉科諾之，潛至偽府，據砲樓大呼，兵士爭血戰。

translations.literal: Yuke agreed, stole into the false palace, seized the gun tower and shouted aloud, and the soldiers fought fiercely in bloody combat.
translations.idiomatic: Yuke agreed, stole into the rebel palace, seized the gun tower and shouted aloud, and his men fought a bloody battle.

sentences.zh: 毓英隱卒城外，度玉科已達，乘夜梯登。

translations.literal: Yuying hid troops outside the city; judging that Yuke had arrived, he scaled the walls by ladder in the night.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying hid troops outside the walls. Judging that Yuke had arrived, he scaled the walls by night.

sentences.zh: 兩軍既合，巷戰竟日，寇披卻，越數日，奪門走。

translations.literal: When the two armies had joined, street fighting lasted a whole day; the rebels were driven back, and after several days they seized the gate and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the two armies joined, street fighting lasted a full day. The rebels were driven back, and after several days they broke through a gate and fled.

sentences.zh: 克偽都，獲文秀家屬及廷棟等百三十人。

translations.literal: The false capital was captured, and Wenxiu's family and Tingdong and others—one hundred thirty persons in all—were taken.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel capital fell. Wenxiu's family and Tingdong and others—one hundred thirty persons in all—were captured.

sentences.zh: 捷入，賞黃馬褂，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When the victory was reported he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket and granted the hereditary office of Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported he was awarded the yellow riding jacket and granted the hereditary rank of Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 十二年，克錫臘、順寧，移師協取雲州，再予一騎都尉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he captured Xila and Shunning, moved his army to assist in taking Yunzhou, and was granted a second Cavalry Captain rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he took Xila and Shunning, moved his army to help take Yunzhou, and was granted a second Cavalry Captain rank.

sentences.zh: 全滇告寧，改一等輕車都尉。

translations.literal: When all Yunnan was declared tranquil his rank was changed to first-class Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: With all Yunnan pacified his rank was raised to first-class Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 明年，入覲，垂詢滇池戰狀，視傷痕惻然。

translations.literal: The following year he went to court audience; the emperor inquired about the fighting at Dianchi, looked at his scars, and was deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he went to audience at court. The emperor inquired about the fighting at Dianchi, looked at his scars, and was deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 光緒改元，還署任，賜頭品服，晉錫二等男。

translations.literal: When Guangxu began his reign he returned to his post, was granted first-rank court dress, and was advanced to second-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Guangxu's reign he returned to his post, was granted first-rank court dress, and was advanced to second-class baron.

sentences.zh: 是時，滇邊野夷殺英官馬嘉理，英公使訴於朝，朝旨趣捕急。

translations.literal: At that time wild tribes on the Yunnan border killed the British official Margary; the British minister protested to the court, and imperial orders urged swift arrest.
translations.idiomatic: At that time border tribes in Yunnan killed the British official Margary. The British minister protested to the court, and imperial orders demanded swift arrest.

sentences.zh: 玉科搜獲而通凹、臘都等十五人，鎖送省城伏誅。

translations.literal: Yuke searched out and captured fifteen men including Ertong'ao and Ladou, sent them in shackles to the provincial capital, and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuke searched out and captured fifteen men including Ertong'ao and Ladou, sent them in shackles to the capital, and they were executed.

sentences.zh: 讞定，會鄧川羅洪昌謀亂，襲州城，遂移師馬甲邑，克東山，擒渠率。

translations.literal: When the case was settled, Luo Hongchang of Dengchuan plotted rebellion and raided the prefectural city; Yuke then moved his army to Majiayi, captured East Mountain, and seized the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was settled, Luo Hongchang of Dengchuan plotted rebellion and raided the prefectural city. Yuke moved his army to Majiayi, took East Mountain, and captured the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 二年，移廣西右江鎮。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to the Youjiang garrison in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to the Youjiang garrison in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 創發，乞解職，疏甫上，適蘇開先陷騰越，勢岌岌。

translations.literal: His old wound reopened and he begged to resign; his memorial had scarcely been submitted when Su Kaixian seized Tengyue and the situation grew perilous.
translations.idiomatic: His old wound reopened and he begged to resign. His memorial had scarcely been submitted when Su Kaixian seized Tengyue and the situation grew desperate.

sentences.zh: 玉科力疾視師，不百日悉平之，被賞賚。

translations.literal: Yuke forced himself despite illness to take command of the army, and in less than a hundred days all was pacified; he was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Yuke forced himself despite illness to take command, and in less than a hundred days all was pacified. He was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三年，徙廣東高州鎮。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to the Gaozhou garrison in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to the Gaozhou garrison in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 六年，署陸路提督，坐其侄汝楫仇殺知府孔昭鈖，鐫三級。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he acted as land regional commander; because his nephew Ruji killed Prefect Kong Zhaofan in a private feud he was reduced three grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he served as acting land regional commander. Because his nephew Ruji killed Prefect Kong Zhaofan in a private feud, he was reduced three grades.

sentences.zh: 尋复。

translations.literal: Soon he was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 十年，法越事起，率師出關，扼觀音橋，法軍至，設三伏敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose; he led his army out of the pass, held Guanyin Bridge, and when the French army arrived he set three ambushes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Franco-Vietnamese war broke out. He led his army beyond the border, held Guanyin Bridge, and when the French arrived he set three ambushes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 聞谷松警，亟往援，而敵已乘虛入，數戰皆利。

translations.literal: Hearing an alarm at Gusong he hurried to its relief, but the enemy had already seized the opening and entered; in several battles all went in his favor.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing an alarm at Gusong he hurried to its relief, but the enemy had already slipped through. In several engagements he held the advantage.

sentences.zh: 明年，法以重兵入關，教民應於內。

translations.literal: The following year the French entered the pass with a heavy force, and sectarian followers responded within.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the French entered the pass with a heavy force, and sectarian followers rose within.

sentences.zh: 玉科曰：「吾百戰餘生，今得死所矣！」

translations.literal: Yuke said, "I have survived a hundred battles; now I have found the place to die!"
translations.idiomatic: Yuke said, "I have survived a hundred battles. Now I have found the place to die!"

sentences.zh: 開關搦戰，中砲亡，諸軍皆潰，至無人收其屍。

translations.literal: He opened the pass and seized the fight; he was struck by cannon fire and died; all the armies broke and fled, until no one even collected his corpse.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the pass and gave battle. He was killed by cannon fire, the army broke and fled, and no one even collected his body.

sentences.zh: 李秉衡蒞關，乃歸其喪，妻牛氏殉焉。

translations.literal: When Li Bingheng arrived at the pass his body was returned; his wife, née Niu, died with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Bingheng arrived at the pass his body was recovered. His wife, née Niu, died with him.

sentences.zh: 追贈太子少保，諡武愍，予大理、鎮南關建祠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous name Wumin, and shrines were granted at Dali and Zhennanguan.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous name Wumin, and shrines were erected at Dali and Zhennanguan.

sentences.zh: 毓英所部多驍將，玉科外，首推李惟述。

translations.literal: Among Yuying's command there were many fierce generals; after Yuke, Li Weishu was foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying's command held many fierce generals. After Yuke, Li Weishu stood foremost.

sentences.zh: 惟述起錦江紳團，嘗與和耀曾施方略，謀所以綴寇，故省城獲保無事。

translations.literal: Weishu rose from the gentry militia of Jinjiang; he had once joined He Yaoceng in devising strategy to check the rebels, and therefore the provincial capital was preserved without incident.
translations.idiomatic: Weishu rose from the gentry militia of Jinjiang. He had joined He Yaoceng in devising strategy to check the rebels, and thus the capital was preserved unharmed.

sentences.zh: 逮馬榮敗，回眾走城外，猶留頓弗去，毓英患之，召惟述計誅其悍將。

translations.literal: When Ma Rong was defeated the Hui masses fled outside the walls but still lingered and would not leave; Yuying was troubled by this and summoned Weishu to plan the execution of their fierce generals.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Rong was defeated the Hui fled outside the walls but lingered and would not leave. Troubled, Yuying summoned Weishu to plan the killing of their fierce generals.

sentences.zh: 悍將故暱惟述，一日，天鄉明，惟述率千人入其壁，悍將方沐，詰所來。

translations.literal: The fierce general had formerly been on intimate terms with Weishu; one day, at daybreak, Weishu led a thousand men into his camp while the fierce general was bathing and asked whence they came.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce general had once been on friendly terms with Weishu. One day at dawn Weishu led a thousand men into his camp while the general was bathing and asked their purpose.

sentences.zh: 惟述曰：「奉上官檄討野夷，不識路徑，故來問。」

translations.literal: Weishu said, "By order of superiors I have been dispatched to campaign against wild tribes and do not know the route, so I have come to ask."
translations.idiomatic: Weishu said, "By superior order I have been sent to campaign against border tribes and do not know the route, so I have come to ask."

sentences.zh: 悍將指畫以示，惟述從其背擊殺之，大呼曰：「為兵者出前門，從逆者出後門！」

translations.literal: The fierce general pointed and drew to show him; Weishu struck and killed him from behind, and shouted aloud, "Soldiers go out the front gate; those who follow the rebels go out the back gate!"
translations.idiomatic: The general pointed out the route. Weishu struck him from behind and killed him, then shouted, "Soldiers go out the front gate! Those who follow the rebels go out the back gate!"

sentences.zh: 回眾驚散，省城遂無寇踪。

translations.literal: The Hui masses scattered in alarm, and thereafter there were no traces of rebels in the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Hui scattered in alarm, and no rebel trace remained in the capital.

sentences.zh: 累勳至都司，補鶴麗鎮游擊。

translations.literal: Through accumulated merit he rose to battalion commander and was appointed mobile corps commander of the He-Li garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Through accumulated merit he rose to battalion commander and was appointed mobile corps commander at the He-Li garrison.

sentences.zh: 克楚雄，遷參將，署維西協。

translations.literal: He captured Chuxiong, was promoted to deputy commander, and acted as commander of the Weixi command.
translations.idiomatic: He took Chuxiong, was promoted to deputy commander, and served as acting commander of the Weixi garrison.

sentences.zh: 與經歷鍾念祖分攻廣通、南安，下之，補順雲協，署開化鎮總兵，仍留駐其地。

translations.literal: Together with Assistant Prefect Zhong Nianzu he divided forces to attack Guangtong and Nan'an and captured them; he was appointed to the Shun-Yun command, acted as regional commander of the Kaihua garrison, and remained stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: With Assistant Prefect Zhong Nianzu he divided forces against Guangtong and Nan'an and took them. He was appointed to the Shun-Yun command, served as acting regional commander at Kaihua, and remained stationed there.

sentences.zh: 無何，寇湧至，城再陷。

translations.literal: Before long rebels poured in and the city fell again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long rebels poured in and the city fell again.

sentences.zh: 惟述慮殘民，佯議和，卒以計脫歸，坐免。

translations.literal: Weishu feared harm to the people, feigned peace talks, and in the end escaped by stratagem; he was punished by dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing harm to the people, Weishu feigned peace talks and escaped by stratagem. He was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 是時，省城复震，馬如龍專倚漢兵守城。

translations.literal: At that time the provincial capital was shaken again; Ma Rulong relied solely on Han troops to defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was shaken again. Ma Rulong relied solely on Han troops to defend the city.

sentences.zh: 惟述分領其眾，內詰姦宄，外禦強敵，省城復安。

translations.literal: Weishu took command of part of his forces, investigated traitors within and resisted strong enemies without, and the provincial capital was again secure.
translations.idiomatic: Weishu took part of the force, rooted out traitors within and resisted strong enemies without, and the capital was secure again.

sentences.zh: 論功，復故官。

translations.literal: For merit he was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 從毓英攻楊林，寇敗潰，然猶堅守小偏橋、十里鋪，冀斷我糧餽。

translations.literal: Following Yuying he attacked Yanglin; the rebels were defeated and routed, yet still held fast at Xiaopian Bridge and Shilipu, hoping to cut off their grain supply.
translations.idiomatic: Following Yuying he attacked Yanglin. The rebels were routed but still held Xiaopian Bridge and Shilipu, hoping to cut off the supply line.

sentences.zh: 惟述乘勝克一撮纓、蕭家山，又與岑毓寶攻克石虎岡，運道始達。

translations.literal: Weishu pressed the victory to capture Yicuoying and Xiaojia Mountain, and together with Cen Yubao captured Shihu Hill, so that the transport route was finally opened.
translations.idiomatic: Weishu pressed the victory to take Yicuoying and Xiaojia Mountain, and with Cen Yubao took Shihu Hill, opening the supply route at last.

sentences.zh: 進平羅次，复楚雄，軍勢大振。

translations.literal: He advanced to pacify Luoci and recover Chuxiong, and military morale rose greatly.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to pacify Luoci and recover Chuxiong, and army morale soared.

sentences.zh: 已而州西又告急。

translations.literal: Before long the west of the province again sent urgent alarms.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the west of the province sent urgent alarms again.

sentences.zh: 毓英謂西軍弛律，咎在諸將不和，乃以大理、麗江軍事屬玉科，而屬惟述以雲、蒙、趙。

translations.literal: Yuying said the western army had grown lax in discipline and blamed discord among the generals; he therefore assigned military affairs in Dali and Lijiang to Yuke and entrusted Yunzhou, Menghua, and Zhaozhou to Weishu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying blamed lax discipline in the western army on discord among the generals. He assigned Dali and Lijiang to Yuke and entrusted Yunzhou, Menghua, and Zhaozhou to Weishu.

sentences.zh: 惟述遂攻克鎮南，鎮南為大理屏蔽，寇以全力死守，至是拔之，寇益蹙。

translations.literal: Weishu then captured Zhennan; Zhennan was the shield of Dali, and the rebels had defended it with all their strength; now that it was taken the rebels grew ever more pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Weishu then took Zhennan, the shield of Dali, which the rebels had defended with all their strength. Its fall left the rebels ever more desperate.

sentences.zh: 上念其苦戰，賜珍物。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful of his bitter fighting, bestowed precious objects.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of his bitter fighting, the emperor bestowed precious gifts.

sentences.zh: 迤西用兵，頻歲饑嗛。

translations.literal: In the western campaign years of famine followed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The western campaign brought years of famine in succession.

sentences.zh: 先是，惟述遣軍攻雲南，久弗克，彌渡亦旋得旋失。

translations.literal: Earlier Weishu had sent troops to attack Yunnan but could not capture it for a long time, and Midu was taken and lost in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Weishu had sent troops against Yunnan but could not take it for a long time, and Midu was won and lost in turn.

sentences.zh: 嗣與玉科謀，乃檄諸軍毋浪戰，期秋穫整軍。

translations.literal: Later he consulted with Yuke and issued orders to all armies not to fight recklessly, planning to reorganize the army after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Later he consulted with Yuke and ordered all armies to avoid reckless fighting, planning to reorganize after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 屆期果大破雲南驛，分兵略彌渡，並克之。

translations.literal: When the appointed day arrived he indeed inflicted a great defeat at Yunnan Station, divided his troops to seize Midu, and captured both.
translations.idiomatic: When the appointed day came, he routed the enemy at Yunnan Station, sent detachments against Midu, and took both places.

sentences.zh: 又與玉科會軍蒙、趙。

translations.literal: He also joined forces with Yuke at Menghua and Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Yuke's army at Menghua and Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 杜文秀者，故永昌累，初匿大小圍埂。

translations.literal: Du Wenxiu had formerly been a servant from Yongchang and at first hid himself at Greater and Lesser Weigeng.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wenxiu was originally a servant from Yongchang and had first taken refuge at Greater and Lesser Weigeng.

sentences.zh: 其據大理也，圍埂回實助之。

translations.literal: When he seized Dali, the Hui of Weigeng had in fact aided him.
translations.idiomatic: When he seized Dali, the Hui of Weigeng had in fact helped him do it.

sentences.zh: 玉科圖取大理，惟述亦統兵克大圍埂，而小圍埂猶據壁自保。

translations.literal: Yuke planned to take Dali; Weishu also commanded troops and captured Greater Weigeng, but Lesser Weigeng still held the walls and defended itself.
translations.idiomatic: Yuke set his sights on Dali. Weishu too led troops and took Greater Weigeng, but Lesser Weigeng still held its walls in stubborn defense.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，轟克之，檄署騰越鎮，收其地。

translations.literal: After more than a year he bombarded and captured it, was appointed by dispatch to the Tengyue command, and recovered its territory.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he blasted it into submission, was appointed by dispatch to the Tengyue garrison, and recovered the region.

sentences.zh: 進攻烏索，未下，遭憂歸，不復出。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Wusuo but did not capture it; he returned home on bereavement and never came out again.
translations.idiomatic: He marched against Wusuo but failed to take it, then withdrew on account of a family bereavement and never returned to the field.

sentences.zh: 久之，卒於家。

translations.literal: After a long time he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In time he died at home.

sentences.zh: 初，玉科嘗殺仇，持其首謁毓英，意詰責即為變。

translations.literal: At first Yuke once killed an enemy, carried his head and called on Yuying, thinking that if questioned and rebuked he would revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Early on Yuke once killed a foe and brought the head to Yuying, expecting rebuke and ready to turn against him if challenged.

sentences.zh: 毓英笑勿問，且善撫之。

translations.literal: Yuying laughed and told him not to speak of it, and moreover treated him kindly.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying only laughed, told him to say no more, and treated him with generous favor.

sentences.zh: 惟述性戇直，業騾馬，初不知希榮貴。

translations.literal: Weishu was by nature blunt and straightforward; he worked at mule and horse trading and at first did not know how to seek glory and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weishu was blunt and plainspoken. He had made his living trading mules and horses and at first had no thought of seeking rank or reward.

sentences.zh: 及奉上賞白玉搬指，適與指合，乃驚嘆天子聖神，益效忠無貳志。

translations.literal: When he received the court's reward of a white jade thumb ring and it happened to fit his finger exactly, he marveled at the Son of Heaven's sacred insight and redoubled his loyalty with no second thought.
translations.idiomatic: When the court bestowed a white jade thumb ring upon him and it fit his finger perfectly, he marveled at the emperor's almost supernatural insight and pledged his loyalty anew without a second thought.

sentences.zh: 所設市肆，悉以「巴圖魯」號名之，其榮幸朝命如此。

translations.literal: Every shop he set up he named entirely with the title "Baturu"; such was his delight in the court's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Every shop he opened he named for the title Baturu—such was his pride in imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 平滇，楊、李功為多，而玉科用兵，則尤神於出沒雲。

translations.literal: In pacifying Yunnan, Yang and Li contributed the most merit, but in Yuke's use of troops he was especially divine at appearing and disappearing like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: In pacifying Yunnan, Yang and Li won the greatest share of credit, yet Yuke's command of troops was unmatched for swift, cloud-like maneuver.

sentences.zh: 蔡標，字錦堂，貴州威寧人。

translations.literal: Cai Biao, styled Jintang, was a native of Weining in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Biao, styled Jintang, came from Weining in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 家貧，落魄無以自資，入滇，設湯餅肆宜良。

translations.literal: His family was poor; destitute and with no means to support himself, he entered Yunnan and opened a noodle shop at Yiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Poor and down on his luck with no way to make a living, he went to Yunnan and opened a noodle shop in Yiliang.

sentences.zh: 以膽略稱。

translations.literal: He was known for his courage and resourcefulness.
translations.idiomatic: He won a reputation for boldness and shrewdness.

sentences.zh: 久之，充練目。

translations.literal: After a long time he was made a drill sergeant.
translations.idiomatic: In time he was appointed a drill sergeant in the local militia.

sentences.zh: 從岑毓英軍克宜良、路南，補把總。

translations.literal: Following Cen Yuying's army he captured Yiliang and Lunan and was appointed platoon captain.
translations.idiomatic: Serving under Cen Yuying, he helped take Yiliang and Lunan and was appointed platoon captain.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，馬榮據省城，毓英堅守籓署，誓與城存亡。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, Ma Rong seized the provincial capital; Yuying held fast in the governor's compound and swore to live or die with the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi, Ma Rong seized the provincial capital. Yuying held the governor's compound and swore to stand or fall with the city.

sentences.zh: 標領死士數十人潛至，叩門入，毓英驚喜。

translations.literal: Biao led several dozen dare-to-die men who stole their way there, knocked at the gate and entered; Yuying was startled and delighted.
translations.idiomatic: Biao slipped in with several dozen picked men, knocked at the gate, and was admitted. Yuying was astonished and overjoyed.

sentences.zh: 標問：「有軍械否？」

translations.literal: Biao asked, "Do you have arms?"
translations.idiomatic: Biao asked, "Do you have arms?"

translations.literal: He was told, "Yes."
translations.idiomatic: Yuying answered, "We do."

sentences.zh: 標曰：「寡不敵眾，奈何？

translations.literal: Biao said, "Few cannot match many—what is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: Biao said, "We are too few to match their numbers. What can we do?

sentences.zh: 當為公募兵！」

translations.literal: We must raise troops openly for you!"
translations.idiomatic: I must raise troops for you in the open!"

sentences.zh: 遂往宜良、路南鳩集舊部，得千人，毓英賴以成軍。

translations.literal: He then went to Yiliang and Lunan to gather his old followers, obtained a thousand men, and Yuying relied on this to form an army.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Yiliang and Lunan, rallied his old followers, and mustered a thousand men on whom Yuying built his army.

sentences.zh: 籓署獲全，標之力也。

translations.literal: The governor's compound was preserved whole—this was Biao's doing.
translations.idiomatic: That the governor's compound was saved was Biao's doing.

sentences.zh: 及馬如龍至，標率效力戰，榮敗走。

translations.literal: When Ma Rulong arrived, Biao led his men to fight with all their strength, and Rong was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Ma Rulong arrived, Biao led his men into fierce fighting and Rong was routed.

sentences.zh: 從征迤東西，連下十餘城，進規曲靖。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign east and west of the province, captured more than ten cities in succession, and advanced to invest Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned across eastern and western Yunnan, took more than ten cities in succession, and advanced against Qujing.

sentences.zh: 寇襲潘文元營，標率三百人頓陶家屯扼後路。

translations.literal: Rebels raided Pan Wenyuan's camp; Biao led three hundred men to encamp at Taojia Village and block their line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels struck Pan Wenyuan's camp, Biao took three hundred men to Taojia Village and blocked their retreat.

sentences.zh: 張保和蹙寇至海壩，標分兵要之，寇潰入城。

translations.literal: Zhang Baohe pressed the rebels to Haiba; Biao divided his troops to intercept them, and the rebels broke and fled into the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Baohe drove the rebels to Haiba. Biao sent detachments to cut them off, and the rebels broke and fled into the city.

sentences.zh: 克曲靖，遷守備，賞花翎。

translations.literal: Qujing was captured; he was promoted to garrison commander and awarded the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: After Qujing fell he was promoted to garrison commander and awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 五年，毓英西征，標引兵從。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Yuying marched west on campaign and Biao led troops to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Yuying marched west, and Biao led his troops with him.

sentences.zh: 時鎮雄降寇复叛，漆維新據子山，李開甲據磺山。

translations.literal: At that time surrendered rebels at Zhenxiong rebelled again; Qi Weixin held Zhuzi Mountain and Li Kaijia held Huangshi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered rebels at Zhenxiong had risen again. Qi Weixin held Zhuzi Mountain and Li Kaijia held Huangshi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 毓英策先攻角奎，令標為前驅。

translations.literal: Yuying planned to attack Jiaokui first and ordered Biao to serve as vanguard.
