translations.idiomatic: Yuying decided to strike Jiaokui first and made Biao his vanguard.

sentences.zh: 抵雄塊，寇出拒，大破之，連拔二山，斬二逆。

translations.literal: Reaching Xiongkuai, the rebels came out to resist and were greatly defeated; both mountains were taken in succession and both rebel leaders were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiongkuai the rebels came out to meet him and were routed. Both mountains fell in turn and both rebel chiefs were slain.

sentences.zh: 明年，從攻豬供箐，與諸將直搗中堅，下之。

translations.literal: The next year he followed the attack on Zhugong Ravine; together with the other generals he struck straight at the enemy center and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he joined the assault on Zhugong Ravine, drove with the other generals straight at the enemy center, and took it.

sentences.zh: 移師海馬姑，奪紅岩、尖山，乘勝薄其柵。

translations.literal: He shifted his army to Haimagu, seized Hongyan and Jianshan, and pressed the enemy palisade on the momentum of victory.
translations.idiomatic: He moved his force to Haimagu, took Hongyan and Jianshan, and pressed the enemy palisade while victory was still hot.

sentences.zh: 標賈勇先登，諸軍鼓譟繼進，擒渠率。

translations.literal: Biao summoned his courage and was first to scale the wall; the armies advanced with drums and shouts, and the rebel chieftain was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Biao led the charge and was first over the wall. The army surged in with drums and war cries and captured the rebel chieftain.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，擢游擊。

translations.literal: Returning in triumph, he was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: On his triumphant return he was promoted to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，署鎮雄營參將。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed acting deputy commander of the Zhenxiong garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made acting deputy commander of the Zhenxiong garrison.

sentences.zh: 會杜文秀偪省垣，標出宜良、湯池，略七甸。

translations.literal: It happened that Du Wenxiu was pressing the provincial capital; Biao marched out through Yiliang and Tangchi and seized Qidian.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wenxiu was pressing the provincial capital. Biao marched out through Yiliang and Tangchi and seized Qidian.

sentences.zh: 未幾，武定、祿勸連告警，復與楊國發攻富民，綴寇勢。

translations.literal: Before long Wuding and Luquan sent alarms in succession; he again joined Yang Guofa to attack Fumin and check the rebel advance.
translations.idiomatic: Soon alarms came in succession from Wuding and Luquan. He joined Yang Guofa again to strike Fumin and slow the rebel advance.

sentences.zh: 寇攻楊林亟，標往援，連破小街、白龍橋巨壘。

translations.literal: The rebels pressed their attack on Yanglin urgently; Biao went to relieve it and in succession broke the great fortresses at Xiaojie and Bailong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels pressed hard against Yanglin. Biao went to the rescue and in succession stormed the great fortresses at Xiaojie and Bailong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 壘甫得，旋复失，勢益熾。

translations.literal: The fortresses had barely been taken when they were lost again, and the rebel power grew ever fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had the fortresses been taken than they were lost again, and rebel strength swelled.

sentences.zh: 標入自長坡，寇殊死戰，不可敗。

translations.literal: Biao entered from Changpo; the rebels fought to the death and could not be defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Biao entered from Changpo, but the rebels fought to the death and could not be broken.

sentences.zh: 翼日，自石子河逾文筆山而下，佯北，誘寇入，攻克東山寺，盡夷楊林寇壘。

translations.literal: The next day he came down from Wenbi Mountain by way of Shizi River, feigned retreat, lured the rebels in, captured Dongshan Temple, and utterly destroyed the rebel fortresses at Yanglin.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he descended from Wenbi Mountain by way of Shizi River, feigned a retreat, drew the rebels in, took Dongshan Temple, and wiped out every rebel stronghold at Yanglin.

sentences.zh: 八年春，援師宗，攻破洛紅甸、豆溫鄉，拔其城。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year he relieved Shizong, broke through Luohongdian and Douwen Township, and captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year he relieved Shizong, broke through Luohongdian and Douwen Township, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 於是嵩明、富民相繼收復，省城始安。

translations.literal: Thereupon Songming and Fumin were recovered in succession, and the provincial capital was at last secure.
translations.idiomatic: Songming and Fumin were then recovered in turn, and the provincial capital was secure at last.

sentences.zh: 明年，威寧陳大桿據紅崖，楊紹貴等據香爐山，四出剽奪。

translations.literal: The next year Chen Dagan of Weining held Hongya, and Yang Shaogui and others held Xianglu Mountain, raiding in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Chen Dagan of Weining held Hongya while Yang Shaogui and others held Xianglu Mountain, raiding in all directions.

sentences.zh: 標越境助擊，誘執陳酋，鎖送州城；

translations.literal: Biao crossed the border to assist in the attack, lured and captured the Chen chieftain, and sent him in shackles to the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Biao crossed the border to help in the attack, lured and captured the Chen chieftain, and sent him to the prefectural city in shackles.

sentences.zh: 吳奇忠亦破香爐山。

translations.literal: Wu Qizhong also broke Xianglu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qizhong also broke Xianglu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 事寧，擢標總兵。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Biao was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored, Biao was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年，諸軍環攻大理偽城，標略其南，力戰一晝夜，克之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the armies encircled and attacked the rebel city of Dali; Biao seized its south and fought fiercely for a day and a night until it was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the armies besieged the rebel city of Dali. Biao swept its southern sector and fought through a day and a night until it fell.

sentences.zh: 南門寇欲竄下關，標復自城追出截擊之，無倖免者，晉提督。

translations.literal: Rebels at the south gate tried to slip away to Xiaguan; Biao again pursued from the city and cut them off, and none escaped; he was promoted to provincial military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels at the south gate tried to slip away toward Xiaguan. Biao pursued from the city and cut them off, leaving none alive, and was promoted to provincial military governor.

sentences.zh: 十二年，移攻雲州，抵猛朗，望見寇壁堅緻，標曰：「此宜先絕外援也！」

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he shifted to attack Yunzhou; reaching Menglang and seeing the rebel fortifications stout and tight, Biao said, "This place should first be cut off from outside aid!"
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he turned to attack Yunzhou. Reaching Menglang and seeing how stout the rebel defenses were, Biao said, "We must cut off their outside support first!"

sentences.zh: 乃遣陸純綱等扼邦蓋、丙弄，而自率師克猛朗，殲其酋丁雁甲。

translations.literal: He then sent Lu Chungang and others to block Banggai and Bingnong, while he himself led the army to capture Menglang and annihilate the chieftain Ding Yanjia.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Lu Chungang and others to hold Banggai and Bingnong, while he led the main force to take Menglang and destroy the chieftain Ding Yanjia.

sentences.zh: 論功，賞黃馬褂，檄署鶴麗鎮總兵。

translations.literal: For merit he was awarded the yellow riding jacket and appointed by dispatch as regional commander of the Heli garrison.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was awarded the yellow riding jacket and appointed by dispatch regional commander of the Heli garrison.

sentences.zh: 全師抵城下，標攻北門，段瑞梅等自東南梯而下，轟擊之，盡殪。

translations.literal: The whole army reached the foot of the city; Biao attacked the north gate while Duan Ruimei and others came down by ladder from the southeast and bombarded them, killing every one.
translations.idiomatic: The full army reached the city walls. Biao assaulted the north gate while Duan Ruimei and others scaled down from the southeast by ladder and blasted the enemy, killing them to the last man.

sentences.zh: 又先後平永北、賓川妖匪，騰越、烏索降匪，開化、大窩子竄匪，更勇號額爾克。

translations.literal: He also in succession pacified the demonic bandits of Yongbei and Binchuan, the surrendered bandits of Tengyue and Wusuo, and the scattered bandits of Kaifeng and Dawozi, and was further granted the honorary title Erke.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to pacify the rebel bands of Yongbei and Binchuan, the surrendered rebels of Tengyue and Wusuo, and the scattered outlaws of Kaifeng and Dawozi, and was further granted the honorary title Erke.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，入覲，道貴州，毓英留統威寧練軍，扼守要隘。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he went to court audience; passing through Guizhou, Yuying kept him to command the Weining militia and hold the strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he went to audience at court. Passing through Guizhou, Yuying kept him to command the Weining militia and hold the strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 已，復平梵淨山餘匪、桐梓會匪、湖南董倒寨回匪。

translations.literal: Afterward he again pacified the remaining bandits of Fanjing Mountain, the secret-society bandits of Tongzi, and the Hui bandits of Dongdaozhai in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He then pacified the remaining bandits on Fanjing Mountain, the secret-society rebels of Tongzi, and the Hui rebels of Dongdaozhai in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 七年，毓英移撫福建，標率滇軍渡台，詔補雲南開化鎮，仍駐台北。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Yuying was transferred as governor to Fujian; Biao led Yunnan troops across to Taiwan, was ordered appointed to the Kaihua garrison of Yunnan, and still remained stationed at Taipei.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Yuying was transferred to Fujian as governor. Biao led Yunnan troops to Taiwan, was appointed to the Kaihua garrison of Yunnan, and remained stationed at Taipei.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，赴本官。

translations.literal: After more than a year he went to his regular post.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he took up his regular post.

sentences.zh: 十年，法越事起，標募舊部出關，宣光、臨洮數戰皆利。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose; Biao recruited his old followers and marched out of the frontier pass; at several battles at Xuanguang and Linshao he was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year war broke out between France and Vietnam. Biao rallied his old followers and marched beyond the frontier, winning several engagements at Xuanguang and Linshao.

sentences.zh: 其守富良江，遍掘地營，法砲不能中，岑軍駐河內者遂不為所窺。

translations.literal: In his defense of the Fu River he dug earthwork camps everywhere so that French cannon could not hit them, and Cen's army stationed at Hanoi was thus no longer exposed to enemy observation.
translations.idiomatic: Defending the Fu River, he dug trench camps everywhere so French artillery could not find its mark, and Cen's army at Hanoi was no longer exposed to enemy fire.

sentences.zh: 著有地營圖說，甚明晰。

translations.literal: He wrote an Illustrated Explanation of Earthwork Camps, which was very clear.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote an Illustrated Explanation of Earthwork Camps, a remarkably clear treatise.

sentences.zh: 十三年，署雲南提督。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed acting provincial military governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed acting provincial military governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 毓英檄治倮黑山軍事，標率師前進，效力合攻，夷緣江百數十壘，誅其魁張春發，拓地千五百里。

translations.literal: Yuying ordered by dispatch that he handle military affairs at Luoduo Black Mountain; Biao led his army forward, exerted himself in the joint attack, destroyed more than a hundred palisades along the river, executed the ringleader Zhang Chunfa, and expanded the territory by fifteen hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying ordered him to handle operations at Luoduo Black Mountain. Biao advanced, fought hard in the joint assault, destroyed more than a hundred riverside palisades, executed the ringleader Zhang Chunfa, and extended the frontier by fifteen hundred li.

sentences.zh: 二十年，錄平永北夷匪、廣南游匪功，賞雙眼花翎、頭品服。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year his merit in pacifying the Yi bandits of Yongbei and the roving bandits of Guangnan was recorded; he was awarded the double-eyed peacock feather and first-grade court dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year his service in pacifying the Yi bandits of Yongbei and the roving rebels of Guangnan was recognized with the double-eyed peacock feather and first-grade court dress.

sentences.zh: 越六年，再入覲。

translations.literal: Six years later he went again to court audience.
translations.idiomatic: Six years later he went to audience at court again.

sentences.zh: 會兩宮西幸，即赴行在，隨扈入陝。

translations.literal: It happened that the two empress dowagers went west on tour; he at once went to the traveling court and followed in escort into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the two empress dowagers fled west, he went at once to the traveling court and followed them into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 抵西安，廷旨命招舊部。

translations.literal: Reaching Xi'an, he received a court order to recruit his old followers.
translations.idiomatic: At Xi'an he received orders from court to recruit his old followers.

sentences.zh: 尋坐約束不嚴褫職，詔念前功，予留任。

translations.literal: Before long he was stripped of office for lax discipline, but an edict mindful of his former merit allowed him to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon stripped of office for lax discipline, but an edict mindful of his past service allowed him to remain in post.

sentences.zh: 明年，還滇，以所部罷弱，解遣之，釋處分。

translations.literal: The next year he returned to Yunnan; because his troops were exhausted and weak he disbanded them, and the penalty was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to Yunnan, disbanded his worn-out troops, and was released from punishment.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，徙廣東瓊州鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to the Qiongzhou garrison of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to the Qiongzhou garrison in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 次年，卒。

translations.literal: The next year he died.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died.

sentences.zh: 附祀毓英祠，予威寧建祠。

translations.literal: He was given secondary sacrifice in Yuying's shrine, and permission was granted to build a shrine for him at Weining.
translations.idiomatic: He was given secondary sacrifice in Yuying's shrine, and a shrine was authorized for him at Weining.

sentences.zh: 瑞梅，字春堂，籍劍川。

translations.literal: Ruimei, styled Chuntang, was registered at Jianchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ruimei, styled Chuntang, was registered at Jianchuan.

sentences.zh: 有勇略，年十六從軍，隸毓英麾下，戰常陷堅。

translations.literal: He had courage and resourcefulness; at sixteen he entered the army, served under Yuying, and in battle often broke the enemy's strongest positions.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and resourceful, he entered the army at sixteen, served under Yuying, and in battle often led the charge against the hardest positions.

sentences.zh: 攻豬供箐、柯渡、大理，並冒險進。

translations.literal: In the attacks on Zhugong Ravine, Kedu, and Dali he always advanced at the risk of his life.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhugong Ravine, Kedu, and Dali he always pressed forward at grave personal risk.

sentences.zh: 歷龍陵營參將，維西、永昌協副將。

translations.literal: He successively served as deputy commander of the Longling garrison and deputy commander of the Weixi and Yongchang brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to deputy commander of the Longling garrison and deputy commander of the Weixi-Yongchang brigade.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年，入覲，賞黃馬褂，予雲騎尉世職，擢記名提督。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he went to court audience, was awarded the yellow riding jacket, granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant, and promoted to recorded-name provincial military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he went to audience at court, was awarded the yellow riding jacket, granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Commandant, and promoted to recorded-name provincial military governor.

sentences.zh: 尋署騰越鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed acting regional commander of the Tengyue garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed acting regional commander of the Tengyue garrison.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，以邊兵亂，城陷，隨復之。

translations.literal: During the Guangxu reign, when frontier troops mutinied and the city fell, he immediately recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu era, when frontier troops mutinied and the city fell, he recovered it at once.

sentences.zh: 後卒於官。

translations.literal: Later he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He later died in office.

sentences.zh: 夏毓秀，字瑯溪，雲南昆明人。

translations.literal: Xia Yuxiu, styled Langxi, was a native of Kunming in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yuxiu, styled Langxi, came from Kunming in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 少以義勇著。

translations.literal: In youth he was known for righteous courage.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was known for righteous valor.

sentences.zh: 滇回亂，以堡長從軍，充選鋒。

translations.literal: When the Hui rebellion broke out in Yunnan, he entered the army as a fort captain and served as a vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hui rebellion broke out in Yunnan, he entered the army as a fort captain and served on the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 昆明被圍久，糧餽阻絕，道殣相望。

translations.literal: Kunming was besieged for a long time; grain supplies were cut off, and corpses lined the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Kunming had been under siege for a long time. Supplies were cut off and the roads were lined with the dead.

sentences.zh: 毓秀率團勇助擊，運道始通，補千總。

translations.literal: Yuxiu led militia to assist in the attack, the transport route was at last opened, and he was appointed company commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiu led local militia into the fight, the supply route was opened at last, and he was appointed company commander.

sentences.zh: 師克路南、祿豐，積勳至守備。

translations.literal: The army captured Lunan and Lufeng; through accumulated merit he rose to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: The army took Lunan and Lufeng, and through accumulated merit he rose to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，岑毓英引兵西，遣毓秀略富民，擒其酋馬富，富，馬榮弟也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, Cen Yuying led troops west and sent Yuxiu to seize Fumin and capture its chieftain Ma Fu; Fu was Ma Rong's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi, Cen Yuying marched west and sent Yuxiu against Fumin. Yuxiu captured the chieftain Ma Fu, Ma Rong's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 乘勝克嵩明、陸涼、武定，署參將。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he captured Songming, Liuliang, and Wuding, and was appointed acting deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Riding the victory he took Songming, Liuliang, and Wuding and was appointed acting deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 毓英慮元謀回撓後路，使毓秀要之。

translations.literal: Yuying feared the Hui of Yuanmou would harass the rear and sent Yuxiu to block them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying feared the Hui at Yuanmou would threaten his rear and sent Yuxiu to hold them.

sentences.zh: 攻克附城巨壘，偪攻縣城，截其糧路，寇患飢乏，棄城走，進复馬街。

translations.literal: He captured the great fortresses outside the city, pressed the attack on the county seat, cut off their grain route, and when the rebels suffered hunger and want they abandoned the city and fled; he advanced and recovered Majie.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed the great outworks, pressed the county seat, and cut their supply line. Hungry and desperate, the rebels abandoned the city and fled, and he advanced to recover Majie.

sentences.zh: 三年，回酋李芳園陷白井，擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the third year the Hui chieftain Li Fangyuan seized Baijing; Yuxiu attacked and drove him back.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Hui chieftain Li Fangyuan seized Baijing. Yuxiu attacked and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 規曲靖，師屢失利。

translations.literal: In the plan to invest Qujing the army repeatedly met defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign against Qujing had met repeated defeat.

sentences.zh: 毓秀至，寇狃數勝，易視之，且登城作謾語。

translations.literal: When Yuxiu arrived the rebels, accustomed to many victories, looked down on him and even mounted the walls to hurl insults.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuxiu arrived the rebels, emboldened by repeated victories, looked down on him and even mounted the walls to hurl taunts.

sentences.zh: 毓秀憤甚，率死士先登，疾擊之，寇大潰，合兵下霑益、馬龍。

translations.literal: Yuxiu was furious; he led dare-to-die men to scale the walls first and struck swiftly; the rebels broke in great rout, and the combined armies captured Zhanyi and Malong.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Yuxiu led his picked men over the walls first and struck hard. The rebels broke and fled, and the combined armies went on to take Zhanyi and Malong.

sentences.zh: 明年，補提標右營游擊，統領四十八堡民兵。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed brigade vice-commander of the provincial banner's right battalion and took command of militia from forty-eight forts.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed brigade vice-commander of the provincial banner's right battalion and placed in command of militia from forty-eight forts.

sentences.zh: 七年，西寇陷祿豐，毓秀敗績，退安寧，分兵扼腰站、祿。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the western rebels took Lufeng; Yuxiu was defeated, withdrew to Anning, and divided his forces to hold Yaozhan and Luquan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the western rebels captured Lufeng. Yuxiu was defeated, fell back to Anning, and sent detachments to hold Yaozhan and Luquan.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，寇湧至，再敗，毓秀退入省城，坐免官。

translations.literal: After a year the rebels surged in; he was defeated again; Yuxiu withdrew into the provincial capital and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the rebels poured in and he was beaten again. Yuxiu retreated into the provincial capital and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 已而寇大舉分道入，馬如龍出大西門御之，參將楊先芝等倒戈相鄉，毓秀被重創。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels came in force by separate routes; Ma Rulong went out the great west gate to meet them; the assistant commanders Yang Xianzhi and others turned their blades against their own side, and Yuxiu was gravely wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebels advanced in force along several routes. Ma Rulong sallied from the great west gate to meet them, but Assistant Commanders Yang Xianzhi and others turned on their own side. Yuxiu was badly wounded.

sentences.zh: 又明年，攻楊林，擊破十里鋪，复官。

translations.literal: The year after that he attacked Yanglin, broke the enemy at Shilipu, and was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he attacked Yanglin, routed the enemy at Shilipu, and was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 毓英規安寧，毓秀自蓖郎繞出碧雞關下，潛師襲大小普坪，克之。

translations.literal: Yuying invested Anning; Yuxiu came round from Bilang below Biji Pass with a hidden force and struck Daxiao Puping, taking it.
translations.idiomatic: While Yuying besieged Anning, Yuxiu circled round from Bilang below Biji Pass with a concealed detachment, surprised Daxiao Puping, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 進取獨樹鋪，會岑毓寶復其城。

translations.literal: He advanced to take Dushupu, and at the same time Cen Yubao recovered that city.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed on to take Dushupu, while Cen Yubao at the same time recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 九年，論克廣通、南安功，遷副將。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, in recognition of the merit in capturing Guangtong and Nan'an, he was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to deputy commander for his part in capturing Guangtong and Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 十年，攻東溝，寇出拒，敗之，師深入，毓秀陷重圍，迳路危C7，棄馬步戰，身受十數刃。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he attacked Donggou; the rebels came out to resist and were defeated; the army pushed deep in; Yuxiu fell into a heavy encirclement; the route was perilous; he abandoned his horse and fought on foot, receiving more than ten blade wounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he attacked Donggou. The rebels sallied and were beaten, but as the army pressed deep Yuxiu was trapped in a heavy encirclement. With the route cut off he dismounted and fought on foot, taking more than ten blade wounds.

sentences.zh: 如龍馳救，舁歸壁，暈眩死，有間蘇，將校環泣，毓秀慨然曰：「丈夫以身許國，馬革裹屍，固大快事！

translations.literal: Rulong galloped to the rescue, had him carried back to the fort; he fainted as if dead; after a while he revived; officers and men wept around him; Yuxiu said with feeling, "A man who pledges his body to the state and is wrapped in horsehide at death is indeed a great joy!
translations.idiomatic: Rulong galloped to his rescue and had him carried back to camp. Yuxiu fainted as if dead; after a time he came round. Officers and men wept around him, and Yuxiu said with feeling, "For a man to give his body to the state and be wrapped in horsehide at death is a great joy indeed!

sentences.zh: 奚悲為？」

translations.literal: Why grieve?"
translations.idiomatic: Why grieve?

sentences.zh: 聞者莫不感奮。

translations.literal: All who heard were stirred and roused.
translations.idiomatic: All who heard him were stirred and roused to fight.

sentences.zh: 創小差，整軍復進，卒夷寇壘，擢總兵，賜號利勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When his wounds had healed somewhat, he re-formed the army and advanced again, finally leveling the rebel strongholds; he was promoted to brigade commander and granted the title Liyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: When his wounds had largely healed, he re-formed the army and advanced again, finally destroying the rebel strongholds. He was promoted to brigade commander and granted the title Liyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 移攻雲州，寇築碉環城誓死守，師久攻不下。

translations.literal: He shifted the attack to Yunzhou; the rebels built blockhouses around the city and swore to die defending it; the army besieged it for a long time without success.
translations.idiomatic: He turned to attack Yunzhou. The rebels built blockhouses around the city and vowed to hold it to the death, and the army besieged it for a long time without success.

sentences.zh: 毓秀先分兵奪碉，孤城危棘，寇無固志，遂拔之，以次復騰越及大小猛統。

translations.literal: Yuxiu first divided his forces to seize the blockhouses; the isolated city was in peril; the rebels lost heart; he took it, and in succession recovered Tengyue and Daxiao Mengtong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiu first sent detachments to seize the blockhouses. With the city isolated and in peril the rebels lost heart, and he took it. He then recovered Tengyue and Daxiao Mengtong in turn.

sentences.zh: 十三年，入覲，上垂視傷痕，慰勞備至，益感激願用命。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he came to court for audience; the emperor looked down at his scars and comforted him with every kindness; he was all the more grateful and willing to give his life in service.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he came to court. The emperor looked at his scars and comforted him with every kindness, and he was all the more grateful and eager to serve.

sentences.zh: 會創發，乞歸。

translations.literal: His wounds then flared up and he begged leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: His old wounds then flared up and he asked leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，赴四川，統領省標十營。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Guangxu reign he went to Sichuan and took command of ten provincial-banner battalions.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Guangxu reign he went to Sichuan and took command of ten provincial-banner battalions.

sentences.zh: 七年，松潘番蠢動，數擾邊，命署總兵治之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Fan of Songpan grew restless and repeatedly disturbed the border; he was ordered to serve as acting brigade commander to deal with them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Tibetan tribes of Songpan grew restless and repeatedly raided the border. He was ordered to serve as acting brigade commander to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 既至，擒首惡，撫良懦，番民以安。

translations.literal: When he arrived he seized the ringleaders, soothed the good and weak, and the Fan people were settled.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he seized the ringleaders, reassured the peaceful and weak, and the tribes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 其地固荒服，設學額百餘年，多為他邑人所佔，謳誦益寂寥。

translations.literal: That region had long been a wild frontier; examination quotas had been set for more than a hundred years, yet most were taken by people from other districts, and the sound of study grew ever more sparse.
translations.idiomatic: The region had long been a remote frontier. Examination quotas had existed for more than a century, yet most places went to men from other districts, and the sound of learning grew ever fainter.

sentences.zh: 毓秀方夷大難，即選聰穎子弟入署讀書，斥私財建書院，廣延名宿，崇化勵賢，至是始聞弦歌聲。

translations.literal: Yuxiu had just quelled a great crisis; he at once selected bright youths to read in his yamen, spent his private funds to build an academy, widely invited eminent teachers, exalted culture and encouraged worthies, and only then was the sound of string and song heard.
translations.idiomatic: Once the great crisis was over, Yuxiu selected bright local youths to study in his yamen, spent his own money to build an academy, invited distinguished teachers, and promoted learning and worthy men. Only then did the sound of study return to the district.

sentences.zh: 九年，實授。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he received formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 蒞鎮十載，培堤岸，濬溝洫，儲倉廩，士民德之，至建生祠以祀。

translations.literal: During ten years in command he built dikes and banks, dredged canals and ditches, and stocked granaries; officials and people honored him, even building a living shrine in his worship.
translations.idiomatic: During ten years in command he built dikes, dredged canals, and stocked granaries. Officials and people honored him so deeply that they built a living shrine to worship him.

sentences.zh: 二十年，朝鮮亂起，日軍侵奉天。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year turmoil broke out in Korea and Japanese troops invaded Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year turmoil broke out in Korea and Japanese troops invaded Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 毓秀自請赴前敵，比入京而和議成。

translations.literal: Yuxiu volunteered to go to the front; by the time he reached the capital peace talks had been concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiu volunteered for the front, but by the time he reached the capital peace had already been made.

sentences.zh: 會鹿傳霖出督四川，奏毓秀自隨，於是再蒞松潘鎮任。

translations.literal: Just then Lu Chuanlin went out to supervise Sichuan and memorialized that Yuxiu should accompany him; Yuxiu then took up the Songpan command again.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Lu Chuanlin was sent to supervise Sichuan and memorialized that Yuxiu should accompany him, and Yuxiu returned to the Songpan command.

sentences.zh: 初，甘肅循化番族拉布浪寺夙強悍，數越界侵掠。

translations.literal: Earlier the Labulang Temple Fan of Xunhua in Gansu had long been fierce; they repeatedly crossed the border to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Labulang Temple Tibetans of Xunhua in Gansu had long been fierce and had repeatedly crossed the border to raid.

sentences.zh: 毓秀初蒞鎮，遣兵防守，安撫餘眾，而拉部擅命如故。

translations.literal: When Yuxiu first took command he sent troops to defend and soothed the rest of the people, but the Labu faction still acted on its own as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuxiu first took command he posted troops on the border and reassured the people, but the Labu faction continued to defy authority as before.

sentences.zh: 既復任，遂率將士出關，克碉十餘，擒渠率，斬以徇諸夷。

translations.literal: After he resumed office he led officers and men out beyond the pass, captured more than ten blockhouses, seized the chieftains, and executed them as a warning to all the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to office he led his officers and men beyond the pass, captured more than ten blockhouses, seized the chieftains, and executed them as a warning to the tribes.

sentences.zh: 諸夷皆伏服，莫敢惕息。

translations.literal: All the tribes submitted; none dared breathe defiance.
translations.idiomatic: All the tribes submitted, and none dared show defiance.

sentences.zh: 蜀邊寧靜，擢提督。

translations.literal: The Sichuan border was quiet, and he was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan border was quiet, and he was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 巴塘西三岩野番數入邊，商旅苦之，號稱「夾壩」。

translations.literal: West of Batang wild Fan of Sanyan repeatedly entered the border; merchants and travelers suffered; they were called the "Jia Ba" bandits.
translations.idiomatic: West of Batang wild tribes of Sanyan repeatedly crossed the border, and merchants and travelers suffered under what was called the "Jia Ba" scourge.

sentences.zh: 毓秀率眾入其部落，招誘首領，宣播朝威，動以禍福利害，諸番皆束首歸命，晉頭品秩。

translations.literal: Yuxiu led his men into their settlements, summoned and won over the chiefs, proclaimed the imperial majesty, and urged them with warnings of harm and benefit; all the tribes bound their heads and submitted; their chiefs were promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiu led his men into their settlements, won over the chiefs, proclaimed the imperial authority, and urged them with warnings of reward and punishment. All the tribes submitted, and their chiefs were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，授貴州提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed regional commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed regional commander of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 會拳亂作，亟統兵入衛。

translations.literal: When the Boxer rising broke out he hastily led troops in to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer rising broke out he hastily led troops to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 抵蒲州，車駕西幸，命率師駐韓侯嶺，許專摺奏事。

translations.literal: Reaching Puzhou, he found the imperial carriage had gone west; he was ordered to lead his army to hold Hanhou Ridge and was permitted to submit memorials directly.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Puzhou, he found the court had fled west. He was ordered to hold Hanhou Ridge with his army and was permitted to submit memorials directly to the throne.

sentences.zh: 明年，調湖北，命分所部留守太原。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Hubei and ordered to leave part of his command to garrison Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to Hubei and ordered to leave part of his command to garrison Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 毓秀以三子瑞符領六營詣防，而自率全軍隨扈北上。

translations.literal: Yuxiu sent his third son Ruifu to lead six battalions to the defense, while he himself led the whole army north in escort.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiu sent his third son Ruifu with six battalions to hold the defense while he himself led the full army north in escort.

sentences.zh: 尋移廣西。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，行次廣東，總督陶模奏署陸路提督。

translations.literal: After a year, while on the road in Guangdong, Governor Tao Mo memorialized that he should act as land regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, while passing through Guangdong, Governor Tao Mo memorialized that he should serve as acting land regional commander.

sentences.zh: 九月，還湖北。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he returned to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he returned to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，創發，卒於官，諡勇恪。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Xuantong reign his old wounds flared up and he died in office; he was posthumously given the honorific Yongke.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Xuantong reign his old wounds flared up and he died in office. He was posthumously given the honorific Yongke.

sentences.zh: 毓秀性忠樸，不治家人生產。

translations.literal: Yuxiu was loyal and plain by nature and did not manage his household's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiu was loyal and plain by nature and took no care for his household's livelihood.

sentences.zh: 治軍數十年，布衣蔬食，見者不知其為專閫雲。

translations.literal: For decades he commanded troops yet wore cloth and ate vegetables; those who saw him did not know he was a regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: For decades he commanded troops yet dressed plainly and ate simply; those who saw him would never have guessed he was a regional commander.

sentences.zh: 何秀林，雲南宜良人。

translations.literal: He Xiulin was a native of Yiliang in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He Xiulin came from Yiliang in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 少從岑毓英軍，攻羅川，襲定遠，略曲靖，每戰必克，累功至守備。

translations.literal: In youth he followed Cen Yuying's army, attacking Luochuan, raiding Dingyuan, and overrunning Qujing; in every battle he prevailed; by accumulated merit he rose to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he served under Cen Yuying, attacking Luochuan, raiding Dingyuan, and overrunning Qujing. He won every battle he fought and rose by accumulated merit to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 討豬供箐，寇悉銳出，圍攻姜飛龍前營，毓英往援，令秀林策應，於是夾擊，大破虜，復進搗中堅，擒其酋陶新春，合師剿克海馬姑，遷游擊。

translations.literal: In the campaign against Zhugongqing the rebels sent out all their best troops and besieged Jiang Feilong's forward camp; Yuying went to relieve them and ordered Xiulin to coordinate from another direction; thus they struck from both sides and routed the enemy; they pressed on to smash the center, captured the chieftain Tao Xinchun, and the combined armies exterminated and took Haimagu; he was promoted to brigade vice-commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Zhugongqing the rebels committed their best troops and besieged Jiang Feilong's forward camp. Yuying went to relieve him and ordered Xiulin to coordinate from another direction. They struck from both sides and routed the enemy, smashed the center, captured the chieftain Tao Xinchun, and the combined armies took Haimagu. Xiulin was promoted to brigade vice-commander.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，西寇圍省城，從毓英自宜良七甸破大小石壟、麻苴、新村，進取大樹營。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi the western rebels besieged the provincial capital; he followed Yuying from Yiliang and Qidian to break Daxiao Shilong, Maju, and Xincun, and advanced to take Dashuying.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tongzhi the western rebels besieged the provincial capital. He followed Yuying from Yiliang and Qidian to break Daxiao Shilong, Maju, and Xincun, and advanced to take Dashuying.

sentences.zh: 運道達，移師呈貢，敗晉寧、昆陽援賊，拔其城，遷副將，賜號效勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The supply route was opened; he shifted troops to Chenggong, defeated relief rebels from Jinning and Kunyang, took their cities, was promoted to deputy commander, and was granted the title Xiaoyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Once the supply route was open he shifted troops to Chenggong, defeated relief rebels from Jinning and Kunyang, and captured their cities. He was promoted to deputy commander and granted the title Xiaoyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 攻澂江，迭克要隘，​​直薄城下，城寇遁，毓英攻西北二門，秀林助之。

translations.literal: In the attack on Chengjiang he took key passes in succession and pressed straight to the foot of the wall; the rebels in the city fled; Yuying attacked the northwest and north gates and Xiulin assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the attack on Chengjiang he took key passes one after another and pressed straight to the walls. When the rebels in the city fled, Yuying assaulted the northwest and north gates and Xiulin assisted him.

sentences.zh: 張元林敗入城，官軍梯而登，馬忠入西門，秀林入東門，元林懼，仰藥死。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuanlin was defeated and fled into the city; government troops scaled the walls; Ma Zhong entered the west gate and Xiulin the east gate; Yuanlin in fear took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuanlin was beaten and fled into the city. Government troops scaled the walls: Ma Zhong entered the west gate and Xiulin the east gate. Yuanlin, in fear, took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 澂江平，與李廷標協守楊林。

translations.literal: When Chengjiang was pacified he and Li Tingbiao jointly garrisoned Yanglin.
translations.idiomatic: After Chengjiang was pacified he and Li Tingbiao jointly garrisoned Yanglin.

sentences.zh: 八年，寇犯邑市舊縣，防軍告亟，秀林赴之，連破馬家衝、前街、邑市。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the rebels invaded Yishi and the old county seat; the garrison sent urgent word; Xiulin went to them and in succession broke Majiachong, Qianjie, and Yishi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the rebels invaded Yishi and the old county seat. The garrison sent urgent word, and Xiulin went to their aid, breaking Majiachong, Qianjie, and Yishi in succession.

sentences.zh: 會廷標亦往援馬龍，兩軍以無主將失和，寇蹈瑕入楊林。

translations.literal: At the same time Tingbiao also went to relieve Malong; the two armies, lacking a chief commander, fell out; the rebels seized the opening and entered Yanglin.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Tingbiao went to relieve Malong. With no overall commander the two armies fell out, and the rebels seized the opening to enter Yanglin.

sentences.zh: 秀林聞警馳還，勵眾堅守，而都司楊桐等先潰，秀林遂陷重圍。

translations.literal: Xiulin heard the alarm and galloped back, roused the men to hold firm, but the battalion commander Yang Tong and others broke first; Xiulin then fell into a heavy encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin heard the alarm and galloped back, urging his men to hold firm, but Battalion Commander Yang Tong and others broke first, and Xiulin was trapped in a heavy encirclement.

sentences.zh: 李惟述援軍弗能至，秀林力盡，潰圍出，被巨創，退保宜良、北屯。

translations.literal: Li Weishu's relief army could not arrive; Xiulin exhausted his strength, broke out of the encirclement, suffered grave wounds, and withdrew to hold Yiliang and Beitun.
translations.idiomatic: Li Weishu's relief force could not reach him. Xiulin fought until spent, broke out of the encirclement with grave wounds, and withdrew to hold Yiliang and Beitun.

sentences.zh: 楊林陷，坐免。

translations.literal: Yanglin fell and he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: When Yanglin fell he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 秀林營員何裔韓傷重幾死，猶攜文卷以行，與秀林收集潰兵，赴省助戰，大板橋之役，與有力焉。

translations.literal: Xiulin's camp officer He Yihan was so badly wounded he nearly died, yet still carried the papers as he went; with Xiulin he gathered the broken troops, went to the capital to help in the fighting, and at the battle of Dabanqiao played an important part.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin's camp officer He Yihan was so badly wounded he nearly died yet still carried the records with him. He joined Xiulin in gathering the broken troops, went to the provincial capital to fight, and played an important part at the battle of Dabanqiao.

sentences.zh: 其秋，攻易門，與署知縣周廷獻克西門、大小龍口及黃泥堆，斷樵汲，分兵佯攻西北，誘寇出，而遣將潛襲西南。

translations.literal: That autumn he attacked Yimen; with Acting Magistrate Zhou Tingxian he took the west gate, Daxiao Longkou, and Huangnidui, cut off firewood and water, sent a detachment to feign an attack on the northwest, lured the rebels out, and sent a general to strike secretly from the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he attacked Yimen. With Acting Magistrate Zhou Tingxian he took the west gate, Daxiao Longkou, and Huangnidui, cut off firewood and water, feigned an attack on the northwest to lure the rebels out, and sent a general to strike secretly from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 秀林督軍衝入，寇惶恐，偽乞撫，秀林弗許，卒大破之，復故官。

translations.literal: Xiulin led the army in a rush; the rebels in alarm falsely begged for surrender; Xiulin would not allow it and finally routed them; he was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin led the army in a charge. The rebels in alarm falsely sued for surrender, but Xiulin refused and routed them completely. He was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 無何，粵寇陷祿豐，秀林約練目丁同義反正。

translations.literal: Before long Guangdong rebels took Lufeng; Xiulin arranged with the drill officer Ding Tongyi to turn and submit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Guangdong rebels captured Lufeng. Xiulin arranged with the drill officer Ding Tongyi to defect back to the government side.

sentences.zh: 同義倒戈以應，秀林分軍奪門入，擒渠率，城遂復，晉總兵。

translations.literal: Tongyi turned his blades to answer; Xiulin divided his army to seize the gate and enter, captured the chieftains, and the city was recovered; he was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tongyi turned on the rebels as agreed. Xiulin divided his force to storm the gate, captured the chieftains, and recovered the city. He was promoted to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，師攻澂江，秀林破城外五山巨壘，寇掘地為營，師久無功。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the army attacked Chengjiang; Xiulin broke the five great mountain strongholds outside the city; the rebels dug earthworks for camps; the army besieged for a long time without success.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the army attacked Chengjiang. Xiulin broke five great mountain strongholds outside the city, but the rebels dug earthworks for camps and the siege dragged on without success.

sentences.zh: 秀林詐退，隱卒誘之，回酋馬敏功等墮其計，並殞於陣，館驛遂無遺寇，進克鐍兮，擢提督。

translations.literal: Xiulin feigned retreat and hid troops to lure them; the Hui chieftains Ma Mingong and others fell into the trap and all perished in battle; the post stations were then cleared of rebels; he advanced and took Kuaixi; he was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin feigned retreat and hid troops to lure the enemy. The Hui chieftains Ma Mingong and others fell into the trap and all died in battle. The post stations were cleared of rebels, and he advanced to take Kuaixi. He was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 明年，補普洱鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed brigade commander of Pu'er.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed brigade commander of Pu'er.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，法越事起，從毓英出關，統三千六百人駐興化。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu, when the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, he followed Yuying beyond the border and commanded 3,600 men garrisoned at Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Guangxu, when the Franco-Vietnamese conflict broke out, he followed Yuying beyond the border and commanded 3,600 men garrisoned at Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 法軍退宣光，勒兵而進，丁槐軍西南，秀林軍東南，攻大寺、大寨，破之。

translations.literal: The French army withdrew to Xuanguang; he led troops forward; Ding Huai's army was to the southwest and Xiulin's to the southeast; they attacked Dasi and Dazhai and took them.
translations.idiomatic: When the French army withdrew to Xuanguang he advanced. Ding Huai's army was on the southwest and Xiulin's on the southeast; together they attacked Dasi and Dazhai and captured them.

sentences.zh: 城內法軍開壁出盪，秀林所部中彈數十人，戰益力。

translations.literal: French troops in the city opened the walls and sallied; several dozen men in Xiulin's command were hit; they fought all the harder.
translations.idiomatic: French troops sallied from the city. Several dozen of Xiulin's men were hit, but they fought all the harder.

sentences.zh: 法軍馳入壁，城外壘柵林立，砲台棋布。

translations.literal: The French army galloped back within the walls; outside the city stockades stood like a forest and batteries were laid out like chess pieces.
translations.idiomatic: The French army galloped back behind the walls. Outside, stockades stood thick as a forest and batteries were laid out in rows.

sentences.zh: 秀林數攻城，為所絓，乃開地道轟潰之，於是攻城無所阻，遂偪城而軍。

translations.literal: Xiulin repeatedly assaulted the city but was checked; he then opened a tunnel and blasted them out; thus the assault met no further obstacle and he pressed the army close to the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin assaulted the city repeatedly but was held off. He then dug a tunnel and blasted the defenses, clearing the way to press his army close to the walls.

sentences.zh: 十一年，法軍數万來援，劉永福軍潰。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year tens of thousands of French troops came to relieve the city; Liu Yongfu's army broke.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year tens of thousands of French troops came to relieve the city, and Liu Yongfu's army was routed.

sentences.zh: 秀林遺馬維騏往救，堅守地營，敵不得逞。

translations.literal: Xiulin sent Ma Weiqi to the rescue; he held firm in the earth camp and the enemy could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin sent Ma Weiqi to the rescue. Ma held firm in the earthwork camp and the enemy could not break through.

sentences.zh: 已而維騏亦被困，秀林至，法軍乃解去。

translations.literal: Before long Weiqi was also trapped; when Xiulin arrived the French army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Weiqi was trapped as well, but when Xiulin arrived the French army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 週視各營，傷亡既眾，不獲已，退頓城下。

translations.literal: He went round the camps; casualties were already heavy; having no choice, he withdrew and encamped below the city.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected the camps and found casualties already heavy. With no choice he withdrew and encamped below the city.

sentences.zh: 策敵必猛攻，豫窖地雷以待。

translations.literal: He judged the enemy would attack fiercely and beforehand buried land mines to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Expecting a fierce enemy attack, he buried land mines in advance.

sentences.zh: 敵果至，雷發，法軍死傷枕藉。

translations.literal: The enemy indeed came; the mines exploded; French troops lay dead and wounded in heaps.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy came as expected. The mines exploded and French troops lay dead and wounded in heaps.

sentences.zh: 秀林乃從容集殘軍，退保同安，圖再舉。

translations.literal: Xiulin then calmly gathered the broken army, withdrew to hold Tong'an, and planned to strike again.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin then calmly regrouped his broken force, withdrew to hold Tong'an, and planned to strike again.

sentences.zh: 和議成，罷戍，移臨元鎮。

translations.literal: When peace was made the garrison was disbanded and he was transferred to the Linyuan command.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was made the garrison was disbanded and he was transferred to the Linyuan command.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 楊國發，雲南建水人。

translations.literal: Yang Guofa was a native of Jianshui in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guofa came from Jianshui in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 討雲南、貴州匪，以戰功數遷至守備。

translations.literal: In campaigns against bandits in Yunnan and Guizhou he was repeatedly promoted for battle merit to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against bandits in Yunnan and Guizhou, he rose by repeated battle merit to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年冬，署提督申有謀攻富民，國髮長左翼，諸生張執中導之出麥廠間道，克黃土坡、永安莊。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth year of Xianfeng, Acting Regional Commander Shen Youmou attacked Fumin; Guofa commanded the left wing; the scholar Zhang Zhizhong guided them out by the secret route through Maichang; they took Huangtupo and Yong'anzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the tenth year of Xianfeng, Acting Regional Commander Shen Youmou attacked Fumin. Guofa commanded the left wing, and the scholar Zhang Zhizhong guided them out by the secret route through Maichang. They captured Huangtupo and Yong'anzhuang.

sentences.zh: 入城，圍攻之，寇棄城走，遷都司，賜號果勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Entering the city they besieged it; the rebels abandoned the city and fled; he was promoted to battalion commander and granted the title Guoyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: They entered and besieged the city. The rebels abandoned it and fled. He was promoted to battalion commander and granted the title Guoyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 明年，進剿祿豐及廣通各井，皆下之。

translations.literal: The next year he advanced to suppress Lufeng and the various wells of Guangtong; all were taken.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he advanced against Lufeng and the various salt wells of Guangtong and took them all.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，從岑毓英西征，連下十餘城，直趨楚雄。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he followed Cen Yuying on the western expedition, taking more than ten cities in succession and pressing straight on Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he followed Cen Yuying on the western expedition, taking more than ten cities in succession and pressing straight toward Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 國發先克古山寺、雙橋巨壘，飛炬焚之，奪東門入，城克。

translations.literal: Guofa first took Gushansi and the great stronghold at Shuangqiao; flying torches burned them; he seized the east gate and entered; the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Guofa first took Gushansi and the great stronghold at Shuangqiao, burned them with fire-arrows, seized the east gate, and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 會大姚告警，國發領兵赴救，破援賊桃花村。

translations.literal: Just then Dayao sent alarm; Guofa led troops to the rescue and defeated relief rebels at Taohuacun.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Dayao sent alarm. Guofa led troops to the rescue and defeated relief rebels at Taohuacun.

sentences.zh: 合城圍，知縣硃士逵舉火應，約期啟關，大姚平。

translations.literal: The combined armies invested the city; Magistrate Zhu Shikui set fires in response; a date was fixed to open the gate; Dayao was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The combined armies besieged the city. Magistrate Zhu Shikui set fires in response, and on the agreed day the gate was opened. Dayao was pacified.

sentences.zh: 移攻鎮南，以寇援大至，檄還省。

translations.literal: He shifted to attack Zhennan, but as rebel relief came in great force he was ordered back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He turned to attack Zhennan, but as large rebel relief forces arrived he was ordered back to the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 三年，權元新營參將，與諸軍拔曲靖，並復霑益、馬龍，再遷至副將。

translations.literal: In the third year he acted as assistant commander of the Yuanxin battalion; with the various armies he took Qujing and also recovered Zhanyi and Malong; he was promoted again to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he acted as assistant commander of the Yuanxin battalion. With the combined armies he took Qujing and also recovered Zhanyi and Malong, and was promoted again to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，廣西州土寇嘯亂，殺游擊陳萃、知縣李瑞枝，國發率師討之，斬其酋張顯，境賴以安。

translations.literal: In the fourth year local bandits in Guangxi Prefecture rose in riot, killing Brigade Vice-Commander Chen Cui and Magistrate Li Ruizhi; Guofa led troops to suppress them, beheaded their chieftain Zhang Xian, and the region was thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year local bandits in Guangxi Prefecture rose in revolt, killing Brigade Vice-Commander Chen Cui and Magistrate Li Ruizhi. Guofa led troops to suppress them, beheaded their chieftain Zhang Xian, and the region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 越三年，西寇圍楚雄亟，國發從間道入，與守將李惟述日夜鏖戰，經月餘，攻不剋，糧盡援絕，城陷。

translations.literal: Three years later the western rebels urgently besieged Chuxiong; Guofa entered by a side route; with the defending commander Li Weishu he fought day and night for more than a month; the attack could not succeed; grain was exhausted and relief cut off; the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later the western rebels urgently besieged Chuxiong. Guofa entered by a side route and, with the defending commander Li Weishu, fought day and night for more than a month. The attack failed, grain ran out, relief was cut off, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 國發冒圍出，仍繞道還省。

translations.literal: Guofa broke out of the encirclement at risk of his life and still made his way back to the capital by a roundabout route.
translations.idiomatic: Guofa broke out of the encirclement at grave risk and still made his way back to the provincial capital by a roundabout route.

sentences.zh: 七年，寇分路大舉，一自富民據城西北，一自安寧據城西南。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the rebels came in force by separate routes; one column from Fumin held the northwest of the city and one from Anning the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the rebels advanced in force along separate routes: one column from Fumin held the northwest of the city and one from Anning the southwest.

sentences.zh: 毓英入援，遣國發扼楊林。

translations.literal: Yuying entered to relieve the city and sent Guofa to hold Yanglin.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying entered to relieve the city and sent Guofa to hold Yanglin.

sentences.zh: 俄而李芳園等悉眾來犯，勢張甚。

translations.literal: Before long Li Fangyuan and others came with all their forces to attack; their momentum was very strong.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Li Fangyuan and others attacked with their full force, and their momentum was very strong.

sentences.zh: 國發告亟，毓英使蔡標赴之，與國發破小街、白龍橋。

translations.literal: Guofa sent urgent word; Yuying sent Cai Biao to him; together with Guofa they broke Xiaojie and Bailongqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Guofa sent urgent word for help. Yuying sent Cai Biao to join him, and together they routed the enemy at Xiaojie and Bailongqiao.

sentences.zh: 旋為寇所乘，地復失，乘勢偪城下，縛草束薪，累積如堵牆，列槍砲其上，俯擊城中，謂之「柴碼兵」，將士損折過半。

translations.literal: Soon they were taken advantage of by the rebels; the ground was lost again; pressing their advantage they came to the foot of the walls; they bound straw and firewood into bundles and piled them like a blocking wall, set spears and cannon on top, and shot down into the city; this was called the "Chaima soldiers"; officers and men suffered losses of more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebels seized their opening and the ground was lost again. Pressing their advantage they came to the foot of the walls, bound straw and firewood into bundles and piled them like a rampart, mounted spears and cannon on top, and fired down into the city. These were called the "Chaima soldiers," and officers and men suffered losses of more than half.

sentences.zh: 國發不獲已，再告亟，請援師，毓英自將兵破之，檄國發署普洱鎮總兵，頓師桃園，接應諸路。

translations.literal: Guofa, having no choice, again sent urgent word and asked for relief troops; Yuying personally led troops to break them; he ordered Guofa to act as brigade commander of Pu'er, encamped at Taoyuan, and supported the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: With no choice Guofa again sent urgent word and asked for relief. Yuying personally led troops to break the enemy, ordered Guofa to serve as acting brigade commander of Pu'er, encamped at Taoyuan, and supported the various routes.

sentences.zh: 八年，尋甸回圍馬龍，國發至，會諸軍戰卻之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Hui of Xundian besieged Malong; when Guofa arrived he joined the armies in battle and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Hui of Xundian besieged Malong. Guofa arrived, joined the armies in battle, and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 夜將半，進掩賊營，乘風縱火，熛煙張天，盡焚其壘，圍解。

translations.literal: Near midnight he advanced to surprise the rebel camp, set fire with the wind, flames filled the sky, all their stockades were burned, and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Near midnight he surprised the rebel camp, set fire with the wind, and flames filled the sky. Every stockade burned, and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 轉鬥逐北，連破十里鋪、小偏橋、長坡六十餘裡，遷總兵。

translations.literal: Turning to fight and pursue north, he captured Shilipu, Xiaopian Bridge, and Changpo in succession over more than sixty li, and was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He turned to pursue the fleeing enemy, took Shilipu, Xiaopian Bridge, and Changpo in succession over more than sixty li, and was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 規彌勒竹園村，馬世德構開、廣回來援，國發破之趙林寨。

translations.literal: Planning against Zhuyuan Village in Mile, Ma Shide stirred the Hui of Kaihua and Guangnan to come to the relief; Guofa defeated them at Zhaolin Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: As he moved on Zhuyuan Village in Mile, Ma Shide stirred the Hui of Kaihua and Guangnan to its relief. Guofa defeated them at Zhaolin Stockade.

sentences.zh: 十年，攻雲南縣，與惟述會軍普淜，分道入，國發迭克要害。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he attacked Yunnan County, joined Weishu at Puxiong, entered by divided routes, and Guofa captured key positions in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he attacked Yunnan County, joined Weishu at Puxiong, and entered by divided routes. Guofa took key positions one after another.

sentences.zh: 寇竄觀音寺，國發麾兵擊之，又毀七碉，直薄城下，與惟述軍合。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Guanyin Temple; Guofa commanded his troops to strike them, destroyed seven blockhouses, pressed straight to the foot of the walls, and joined Weishu's army.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Guanyin Temple. Guofa struck them, destroyed seven blockhouses, pressed to the foot of the walls, and joined Weishu's army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，轟裂城垣三十餘丈，相繼而登，巷戰一晝夜，拔之，留所部守其地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he blasted more than thirty zhang of the city wall, scaled it in succession, fought in the streets for a day and a night, took the city, and left his own troops to garrison the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he blasted more than thirty zhang of the wall. His men scaled it in waves, fought in the streets for a day and a night, and took the city. He left his troops to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 秋，徙鎮下關，進圍榆城，先後克大小圍埂，擢提督，賞黃馬褂，更勇號綽勒歡。

translations.literal: In autumn he moved his command to Xiaguan, advanced to besiege Yucheng, captured the great and small Weiheng stockades in turn, was promoted to regional commander, rewarded with a yellow riding jacket, and his brave title was changed to Chuoleguan.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he moved to Xiaguan, besieged Yucheng, and took the great and small Weiheng stockades in turn. He was promoted to regional commander, awarded the yellow riding jacket, and granted the new title Chuoleguan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，再權普洱鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he again acted as commander of the Pu'er garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he again served as acting commander of the Pu'er garrison.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，毓英撫福建，國發率師駐台北。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, when Yuying became governor of Fujian, Guofa led his army to garrison Taipei.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu, when Yuying became governor of Fujian, Guofa led his army to garrison Taipei.

sentences.zh: 明年，還雲南。

translations.literal: The following year he returned to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十年，從毓英援越南宣光、臨洮，每戰皆克，予優敘。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he followed Yuying to relieve Xuanguang and Linshao in Vietnam; in every battle he prevailed and was granted preferential record of merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he followed Yuying to relieve Xuanguang and Linshao in Vietnam. He won every engagement and received preferential record of merit.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，附祀毓英祠，予本籍建祠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died; he was granted associated worship at Yuying's shrine and a shrine in his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he died. He was honored with associated worship at Yuying's shrine, and a shrine was erected in his native place.

sentences.zh: 張保和，雲南師宗人。

translations.literal: Zhang Baohe was a native of Shizong in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Baohe was a native of Shizong in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 初從岑毓英討回寇，積功至守備。

translations.literal: At first he followed Cen Yuying in campaigning against the Hui rebels and through accumulated merit rose to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He first followed Cen Yuying against the Hui rebels and through accumulated merit rose to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，越境討豬供箐，屢獲勝。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tongzhi he crossed the border to campaign at Zhugong Ravine and won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tongzhi he crossed the border to campaign at Zhugong Ravine and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 寇竄海馬姑，復與蔡標等合擊之。

translations.literal: When the rebels fled to Haimagu he again joined Cai Biao and others in a combined attack.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels fled to Haimagu he again joined Cai Biao and others in a combined attack.

sentences.zh: 攻大寨，悍酋張項七死拒，保和執予以刺，墮馬，梟其首，寇氣懾，諸軍乘之，大捷，遷游擊。

translations.literal: Attacking the great stockade, the fierce chieftain Zhang Xiangqi resisted to the death; Baohe seized him and stabbed him, fell from his horse, displayed his head, the rebels' spirit was cowed, the armies pressed the advantage, won a great victory, and he was promoted to mobile corps commander.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking the great stockade, the fierce chieftain Zhang Xiangqi resisted to the death. Baohe seized and stabbed him, fell from his horse, and displayed his head. The rebels' spirit broke, the armies pressed the advantage and won a great victory, and he was promoted to mobile corps commander.

sentences.zh: 明年，西寇圍省城，毓英入自曲靖，遣保和為前鋒，攻克石虎岡，馳救邵甸，破之。

translations.literal: The following year western rebels besieged the provincial capital; Yuying entered from Qujing, sent Baohe as vanguard, captured Shihu Hill, hurried to relieve Shaodian, and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The next year western rebels besieged the capital. Yuying entered from Qujing, sent Baohe as vanguard, took Shihu Hill, hurried to relieve Shaodian, and defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 移師楊林，迭克要害，皆揮矛衝陣，所向輒靡。

translations.literal: He moved his army to Yanglin, captured key positions in succession, always brandishing his spear to charge the battle line, and wherever he went the enemy gave way.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Yanglin and took key positions in succession, always charging the line with spear in hand. Wherever he went the enemy gave way.

sentences.zh: 寇見保和旗幟即反奔，無敢與抗者。

translations.literal: When rebels saw Baohe's banners they turned and fled, and none dared stand against him.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels saw Baohe's banners they turned and fled. None dared stand against him.

sentences.zh: 數負重傷，裹創力戰，氣不少沮。

translations.literal: He was wounded many times, bound his wounds and fought on, and his spirit never flagged.
translations.idiomatic: He was wounded many times, bound his wounds and fought on, and his spirit never flagged.

sentences.zh: 先後攻克呈貢、晉寧、富民、嵩明，大小百餘戰，未嘗一挫。

translations.literal: In succession he captured Chenggong, Jinning, Fumin, and Songming; in more than a hundred battles large and small he never suffered a single defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He took Chenggong, Jinning, Fumin, and Songming in turn. In more than a hundred battles large and small he never suffered a defeat.

sentences.zh: 省圍解，遷副將，賜號揚勇巴圖魯，署楚雄協。

translations.literal: When the provincial siege was lifted he was promoted to deputy regional commander, granted the title Yangyong Batulu, and appointed acting commander of the Chuxiong garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege of the capital was lifted he was promoted to deputy regional commander, granted the title Yangyong Batulu, and appointed acting commander of the Chuxiong garrison.

sentences.zh: 規昆陽，遣都司陳貴等自津徑取河西鄉，而自率師攻仁和街，越牆而入，手刃悍寇數人，一鼓克之，河西亦平，於是城圍合。

translations.literal: Planning against Kunyang, he sent Brigade Commander Chen Gui and others by the ford route to take Hexi Township, while he himself led the army to attack Renhe Street, scaled the wall, killed several fierce rebels with his own hand, took it at one stroke, Hexi was also pacified, and thus the siege of the city was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Moving on Kunyang, he sent Brigade Commander Chen Gui by the ford route to take Hexi Township while he led the main force against Renhe Street. He scaled the wall, killed several fierce rebels with his own hand, and took the place at one stroke. Hexi was pacified as well, and the siege closed around the city.

sentences.zh: 保和揆形勢，謂宜先克海口，因勒兵以進，村民爭迎附，二十餘寨皆下，遂復州城，署開化鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Baohe judged the situation and said Haikou should be taken first; he pressed his army forward, villagers vied to welcome and submit, more than twenty stockades all fell, the prefectural city was recovered, and he was appointed acting regional commander of the Kaihua garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Baohe judged that Haikou must be taken first. He pressed forward, villagers vied to submit, and more than twenty stockades fell. The prefectural city was recovered, and he was appointed acting regional commander at Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 九年春，攻彌勒竹園，馬世德赴救，保和迎擊之，身先陷陣，彈貫鼻及眼，血盈面，士卒憤懣，卒大破之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year he attacked Zhuyuan in Mile; Ma Shide came to the relief and Baohe met him in battle, plunged first into the line, was shot through nose and eye, blood covered his face, the soldiers were filled with rage, and in the end the enemy was thoroughly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year he attacked Zhuyuan in Mile. Ma Shide came to the relief and Baohe met him head-on, plunging first into the line. A bullet pierced his nose and eye and blood covered his face. His soldiers were enraged and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 連克上下壩，竹園平。

translations.literal: He captured the upper and lower dams in succession and Zhuyuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He took the upper and lower dams in succession, and Zhuyuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 赴本官，更勇號曰剛安。

translations.literal: He went to his substantive post and his brave title was changed to Gang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He took up his substantive post, and his title was changed to Gang'an.

sentences.zh: 進取茂克，戰數捷，阿迷、大莊望風讋憚。

translations.literal: Advancing to take Maoke, he won several victories in battle, and Ami and Dazhuang were cowed at the mere report of his approach.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Maoke he won several victories, and Ami and Dazhuang were cowed at the mere report of his approach.

sentences.zh: 奪後山，增築砲台，俯瞰其寨，日夜轟擊之，汲路絕。

translations.literal: He seized the rear hill, built additional gun emplacements overlooking their stockade, bombarded it day and night, and cut off their route to draw water.
translations.idiomatic: He seized the rear hill, built gun emplacements overlooking their stockade, bombarded it day and night, and cut off their water route.

sentences.zh: 寇駭乞降，保和許之，收器械，捕惡黨，徙降回大莊。

translations.literal: The rebels, terrified, begged to surrender; Baohe consented, collected their weapons, arrested the wicked ringleaders, and moved the surrendered Hui to Dazhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, the rebels begged to surrender. Baohe consented, collected their weapons, arrested the ringleaders, and moved the surrendered Hui to Dazhuang.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以次復田心、日者鄉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he recovered Tianxin and Rizhe Township in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he recovered Tianxin and Rizhe Township in succession.

sentences.zh: 時趙發攻鐍兮未下，保和自開化馳剿。

translations.literal: At that time Zhao Fa was attacking Suoxi but had not taken it; Baohe hurried from Kaihua to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fa was then attacking Suoxi without success. Baohe hurried from Kaihua to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 直抵馬街，破上下兩寨，徙降回新興，擢提督。

translations.literal: He pressed straight to Majie, broke the upper and lower stockades, moved the surrendered Hui to Xinxing, and was promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed straight to Majie, broke the upper and lower stockades, moved the surrendered Hui to Xinxing, and was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 十二年，論克騰越功，賞黃馬褂，授鶴麗鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, for merit in capturing Tengyue, he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket and appointed regional commander of the He-Li garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, for merit in taking Tengyue, he was awarded the yellow riding jacket and appointed regional commander of the He-Li garrison.

sentences.zh: 十三年，開化大窩子土夷复叛，毓英收撫之，檄保和再蒞開化鎮任，發兵二千，責千總李瑤等戍其地。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the native tribes of Dawozi in Kaihua rebelled again; Yuying pacified them, ordered Baohe by dispatch to resume the Kaihua command, sent two thousand troops, and charged Battalion Commander Li Yao and others to garrison the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the native tribes of Dawozi in Kaihua rebelled again. Yuying pacified them, ordered Baohe back to the Kaihua command, sent two thousand troops, and charged Battalion Commander Li Yao and others to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 瑤等縱兵凌虐，於是土夷大憤。

translations.literal: Yao and the others let their troops oppress and abuse the people, and the native tribes were greatly enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Yao and his men let their troops abuse the people, and the native tribes were greatly enraged.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，光緒改元，回酋馬河圖嗾與漢民閧，保和慾樹功，與署知府姚嘉驥侈張其事，請調兵數千，發餉巨萬，剋期大舉。

translations.literal: After more than a year, when Guangxu began his reign, the Hui chieftain Ma Hetu incited a brawl with Han civilians; Baohe wished to build merit, and together with Acting Prefect Yao Jiaji exaggerated the affair, requested several thousand troops, vast funds, and a set date for a major campaign.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, at the beginning of Guangxu's reign, the Hui chieftain Ma Hetu incited a brawl with Han civilians. Baohe wished to win merit and, with Acting Prefect Yao Jiaji, exaggerated the affair, requesting several thousand troops, vast funds, and a set date for a major campaign.

sentences.zh: 毓英廉得實，斥之。

translations.literal: Yuying investigated and learned the truth and rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying investigated, learned the truth, and rebuked them.

sentences.zh: 保和怒，乃罷戍，以失守聞。

translations.literal: Baohe was angry, withdrew the garrison, and reported the place lost.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Baohe withdrew the garrison and reported the post lost.

sentences.zh: 毓英遣何秀林進擊，保和诇將至，宵入燔數寨，稱克復。

translations.literal: Yuying sent He Xiulin to attack; Baohe learned through reconnaissance that he was coming, entered by night and burned several stockades, and claimed recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying sent He Xiulin to attack. Baohe learned through scouts that he was coming, entered by night and burned several stockades, and claimed recovery.

sentences.zh: 毓英乃罷保和。

translations.literal: Yuying then dismissed Baohe.
translations.idiomatic: Yuying then dismissed Baohe.

sentences.zh: 明年，調湖南永州鎮。

translations.literal: The following year he was transferred to the Yongzhou garrison in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to the Yongzhou garrison in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he died.

sentences.zh: 保和在滇將中以智勇著，功亦盛。

translations.literal: Among the generals of Yunnan Baohe was renowned for wisdom and courage, and his achievements were also great.
translations.idiomatic: Among Yunnan's generals Baohe was renowned for wisdom and courage, and his achievements were great.

sentences.zh: 其卒也，年未四十，時人惜之。

translations.literal: When he died he was not yet forty, and men of the time mourned him.
translations.idiomatic: He died before the age of forty, and men of his time mourned him.

sentences.zh: 論曰：滇回初起，勢頗盛，自如龍反正，其氣始衰。

translations.literal: The commentator says: When the Yunnan Hui first rose their power was quite strong, but from the time Rulong returned to allegiance their momentum began to decline.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: When the Yunnan Hui first rose their power was formidable, but from the time Rulong returned to allegiance their momentum began to fail.

sentences.zh: 然非有以善馭之，剿撫兼施，滇事亦未易定也。

translations.literal: Yet without skillful control, combining suppression and conciliation, the Yunnan affair would not have been easy to settle either.
translations.idiomatic: Yet without skillful leadership that combined suppression and conciliation, the Yunnan affair would not have been easily settled.

sentences.zh: 耀曾善於結士，玉科神於用兵，標等皆善攻堅；

translations.literal: Yaoceng was skilled at rallying warriors, Yuke was masterful in the use of troops, and Biao and the others were all skilled at storming strongholds;
translations.idiomatic: Yaoceng excelled at rallying warriors, Yuke was masterful in warfare, and Biao and the others excelled at storming strongholds;

sentences.zh: 而毓秀忠樸，兵後能崇儒興學，尤稱知本，民建生祠以祀之，宜哉！

translations.literal: while Yuxiu was loyal and plain, and after the war was able to honor Confucian learning and promote schools—especially praised for knowing what is fundamental—the people built a living shrine to worship him, as was fitting!
translations.idiomatic: while Yuxiu was loyal and plainhearted and, after the war, honored Confucian learning and promoted schools—especially praised for grasping what truly matters—the people built a shrine in his honor while he still lived. And rightly so!
